data.about_the_game:
You’ve just moved into a new city. Your house’s a bit of a fixer-upper. You don’t know anyone yet. And somehow... that’s kind of exciting.

Little Sim World is a 2D life sim made with love by an indie team who’ve always dreamed of building a cosy little world you could truly call your own. We surveyed over 10,000 hardcore sim fans to find out what they wanted in a life simulation game, and we've packed Little Sim World with all the must-have features! Explore the streets of Little London, decorate your dream home, meet lovely (and sometimes odd) locals, and live your life however you choose!

Your Little is all yours! From personality traits to face and hairstyle, you’ll have loads of cute and cool options to be whoever you want to be.

And whenever you’re tired of your look - or just fancy something new - feel free to pop by the local Saloon for a fresh haircut or a makeup retouch!

Dress the way you feel, not just the way you look. Whether it’s bold, comfy, quirky or classic, there’s an outfit for every side of you. Shop, colour, save, repeat—and watch your wardrobe grow alongside your story.

Little London might not be big, but it’s packed with life. We poured a lot of love into our city, and it’s all yours to explore with no loading screens or transitions—just the entire world at your disposal!

Drop by at Simon’s Pub or Moon Cafe for a good meal, or just grab some snacks on the go from the food trucks around. Grab some groceries at LetsGo, or shop for new furniture at Futton. Pop into the Museum to check and expand your collections, pick out a new book at the Library, or just watch as life goes by from your favourite Park bench—and loads more!

People in Little London always look out for each other!

The Notice Boards across the city are filled with little requests from neighbours in need—small requests, quiet favours, tiny acts of care. Help out when you can, earn a few crowns, and maybe discover that doing good feels surprisingly… Good.

Don’t forget that your Little gets sleepy and thirsty too, so make sure to take care of your needs as you go about your day.

There are 8 different stats you'll need to manage, from your health & happiness to your comfort and bladder. Every activity, whether it's crafting, working out, or fishing, affects your needs in unique ways. Plan accordingly to ensure you stay balanced.

Each Little has their own set of skills and interests! Around the city, you’ll find loads of ways to grow and develop them. Go fishing by the lake, paint and sell your work at the Art Park, grow into a master chef by cooking delicious meals, hit the gym, or become a bestselling author by honing your writing skills!

As you develop your Little’s skills, you’ll unlock special rewards like new outfits, new interactions, and, most importantly, Perks! Upon reaching certain skill levels, you’ll be able to choose a Perk that boosts your abilities and helps you be even better at the things you love doing.

Once that itch to learn kicks in, it’s time to enroll at the local University! Head to class, grow your skills, meet new people, and work towards the degree that feels right for you.

A new city means a new home - and once you first move in, you’ll find that yours will need a lot of love. But luckily in Little Sim World, everything’s customisable!

From wallpaper patterns to furniture colours, you’ll be able to tailor each little corner of your house to fit your taste. Repaint the walls, swap out the furniture, expand your plot, or bulldoze the whole thing and start from scratch. We built this world for you—make it feel like it!

Little London is full of life! There are loads of characters around town for you to meet and build connections with - each with their own personality, dreams, and backstory.

A melancholic boat captain hoping to reconnect with his son. A barista who dreams of becoming an idol. An insecure author who needs help to believe in herself. Soon, you’ll notice that the real magic of Little London comes not from the place, but from the people who live in it. From the serious and mysterious head of the University’s student council to the “go big or go home” fitness influencer, there are tons of characters to get to know - perhaps even more intimately.

Life’s not always easy, even in a cosy city like this. When a mysterious newcomer shows up with plans that could change everything for their own profit, it’s up to you and your new friends to protect the place that has become your home. This story needs someone to stand up for what matters—and that someone might just be you!

It’s nice doing things solo, but sometimes life’s better with friends, right? In multiplayer mode, up to five players can play and build memories together!

Share a house, or just drop by for a casual visit. This story is all yours to write as you wish!

data.about_the_game:
Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies, go viral, and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

Internet Survivor Survivors is a top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame,

in which you play as Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!?

Lots of other familiar Touhou characters make appearances too, of course!

Game Description

-Just keep on beating enemies and never stop! ...Hey, haven't I seen these things online before!?

-Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons and stats!

-For a streamer, their very viewer count is their life! Beat enemies to gain viewers, but get hit and you'll lose some!

-If you lose all your viewers, Flan's phone will break and it'll be game over!

-Keep streaming until time runs out and you'll clear the stage!

-Simple controls let you have stress-free fun! C'mon, just give it a try and you'll see!

Story

My name's Flandre Scarlet! I'm a newbie streamer, but I've got a LOT of eyes on me!

Weird content, fun stuff, freaky memes, whatever... I'll play with all of you, no exceptions!

I'm gonna destroy things, grow my numbers, and go viral! My goal is 1 million subs!

Just you wait, big sis Remilia! I'll catch up to you in no time!

About This Game

This game is a fangame based on the Touhou Project series,

and isn't an official work created by Team Shanghai Alice.

data.about_the_game:
Flowers and Deities is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite set in a rainforest world ruled by bloodthirsty gods. Lead your army to battle and spend spilled blood as a resource to cast spells and summon creatures. Die, adapt, and descend into the arena again.

Choose from 4 origins and faiths that define your playstyle from the first fight. Battle across multiple grand arenas against 15+ races and 125+ unique unit types. Face noble legions, barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, and alien visitors. Defeat them, and conscript them into your own ranks.

The build space is expansive: 12 tactical archetypes, 300+ magical items, 100+ divine blessings, and 50+ status effects. A flexible equipment and slot system lets you experiment freely, counter enemy weaknesses mid-run, and find combinations the gods never intended.

Blood is your most precious resource. Every unit lost - no matter yours or theirs - fills the pool. Spend it to turn the tide. Combat arena getting dry? Sacrifice your kin and claw out that victory with the power Gods bestow upon you. 

Key Features

  • 4 origins and faiths - distinct starting builds that shape your entire run

  • 125+ unique units across 15+ races - recruit enemies you defeat and grow your legion

  • Vast build space - 12 archetypes, 300+ items, 100+ blessings, 50+ status effects

  • Blood is resource - every death fuels your next move

  • 6 grand arenas - escalating enemies including barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, alien visitors, and legendary beasts

data.about_the_game:
Step into the captivating handcrafted pixel-art world of Shoru, a land inhabited by powerful creatures known as Creo. These majestic creatures have existed for millennia and yet their origins remain shrouded in mystery. Work alongside Creo companions to discover the truth!

Begin your journey as a new cadet in the Shoru Police Academy. Investigate the mysterious disappearances of Creo across the land. Thwart nefarious plots, uncover ancient secrets, and explore the continent of Shoru with more than 50 missions expanding the world and its lore.

Discover over 300 extraordinary Creo to capture and befriend along the journey. Assemble powerful teams, experiment with synergies, and find your favorite combinations. Find Creo in multiple color variations—collect them all and make a special one-of-a-kind team. Whether you prefer brute strength, tactical control, or status effects, there’s a Creo to match every strategy.

Experience over 30 hours of offline gameplay in a stunningly crafted pixel-art world. Step into hidden caves, walk through bustling cities, or tiptoe through active volcanoes. Witness all of Shoru’s lively biomes!

Synergize over 100 traits, equippable items, and 200+ unique moves to power up Creo for an upcoming boss fight or competing with friends in PvP battle. Prepare your Creo companions to become victorious against any challenge.

Battle fellow cadets across the globe in Online Ranked Battles, or challenge your friends in casual matches. Prefer a solo experience? You can enjoy the full adventure completely offline.

Challenge powerful Evokers across Shoru’s many locales and rise to the top to conquer the Coliseum. Only the best of the best can earn the coveted title of Evoking Master!

• 30+ hours of offline story-driven gameplay
• Over 300 Creo to capture, train, and evolve
• No level caps on your monsters
• Deep battle mechanics with hundreds of moves and traits
• Competitive online battles and ranked matchmaking [Coming Soon]
• Fully offline-capable — no internet required
• Multiple color variants for every Creo

data.about_the_game:
Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute & cozy puzzle adventure made in collaboration with Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula, author and illustrator of the Tukoni books. Play as Traveller, a forest spirit on a special journey, as you explore magical hand-drawn locations, meet charming characters, solve handcrafted puzzles, collect herbs and tea recipes, and help the forest prepare for the coming winter.

A magical world brought to life

Step inside the world of Tukoni, where gentle forest spirits live alongside animals and care for the world around them.

Some Tukoni look after plants and trees, while others watch over the changing seasons from the Heart of the Forest. This autumn, Traveller is called on a special journey to help the forest prepare for the coming winter.

Explore four hand-drawn locations filled with tiny homes, hidden paths and curious details, and discover a forest where nature and everyday life are inseparable.

Help the forest prepare for winter

The Month of the Mushroom has begun, and there is plenty to do before the first frost arrives.

While some animals prepare to enter the world of winter dreams, others are getting ready to face the cold months ahead. The Forest Keepers are busy too — preparing supplies, making pillows and making sure everyone has what they need.

Join Traveller on his special mission and meet around 20 inhabitants of the forest along the way. Help them finish their autumn tasks, learn their little quirks and stories, and perhaps stay for a cup of tea before setting off again.

Dozens of puzzles woven into the forest

Every backpack is made to be filled, every lock has its key, and everything that has become mixed up will eventually find its way back where it belongs.

Solve dozens of handcrafted puzzles and mini-games inspired by the places you visit and the characters you meet. Look for clues, arrange objects, unlock tricky locks, gather what someone needs and find creative solutions to the little problems you encounter along the way.

And whenever an important detail might otherwise slip away, Traveller has his trusty moss-covered Notebook. Filled with sketches and memories of your journey, its pages can hold just the clue you need to keep going.

Learn the art of tea

There's no greater gift than sharing a cup of fragrant herbal tea with a friend.

Meet Tea Tukoni, the forest's resident tea expert, and learn the art of brewing from a true professional. Earn your own Tea Ceremony Box, discover new recipes, gather herbs throughout your journey and prepare different brews for the characters you meet.

Because in the world of Tukoni, making tea is more than mixing ingredients. Plants nurtured by the sun carry the scents of summer fields and autumn gardens — and with a little care, you can put all of that warmth into a cup.

Take a much-deserved break

Not every moment in the forest needs a task.

Hidden throughout your journey are cozy spots — little nooks where Traveller can settle in, pause the adventure for a moment and simply enjoy the sights and sounds of nature.

Rest beneath the autumn leaves. Draw in your Notebook. Sit by a gentle stream.

And whenever you're ready, pick up your backpack, and continue your journey.

A wholesome adventure for all ages

With its charming hand-drawn world, gentle puzzles and heartwarming characters, Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a family-friendly adventure that parents and children can enjoy together.

Whether it's a lazy afternoon or a chilly evening, cozy up with Tukoni and escape into a world of warmth and wonder — a place to unwind, enjoy the little things and spend some time together.

data.about_the_game:
In Monsters are Coming! gather what resources you can to defend an ever-moving city. Are you ready to take on a never-ending army of darkness in a tower-survivor, action-rogue-lite on wheels?

- Fortify: The city must endure! Choose from a selection of town halls, place towers and create your own builds to maximise destruction. Equip defensive structures to repel monsters from the gates and keep the city moving forward, else the darkness will consume you!

- Forage: Gather wood, stone and gold as a persistent, multi-tasking hero. You must constantly balance risk vs reward while fighting back endless armies of monsters. Stray from the beaten path to find richer rewards or keep heading due south towards the safety of shelter.

- Fight: Beat Bad-Ass bosses, improve your abilities, overcome environmental obstacles and take charge of special weaponry to continually adapt your strategies. Or see your city turned to ash!

You’re the last hope for humanity, but it’s a long road to the Ark.

- Build your city your way. Reach shelter and buy new districts from the city shop. Then strategically choose where to place them  based on the needs of each run.

- Defend yourself. Choose from a variety of unique Town Halls, then add archery outposts, necromancer towers, and even fire-breathing dragons to protect it from the dangers beyond the walls.

- Unlock new possibilities: Find a build that works for you, keep upgrading and try to stay alive against increasingly powerful monsters the closer you get to the Ark!

-  Keep the city stocked: Gather wood to keep the engines burning and increase tower efficiency, chisel stone to help repair and rebuild, and mine gold to expand your moving fortress of destruction. 

-  Never stop moving:  Collect compasses at the end of each run and pay your attempts forward, making it easier for future cities to find their way to the Ark!

-  Explore for bonuses: Look for hidden secrets in shelters and tackle side hordes to find richer, rarer rewards. Just make sure you get back to your city in time!

- Progress to Prevail: Level up, increase your potential through vast player progression, and protect the city at all costs, even at the hero’s expense!

- The City Still Stands: Even if the Hero falls, it’s not game over! A run only ends once the city is destroyed, so quickly jump back into the fight before all hope is lost.

- Bad Ass Bosses: Getting to the Ark won’t be easy and there may be some larger monsters waiting for you at the periphery…

data.about_the_game:
Establish the greatest regime in history in this darkly satirical colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid. Build a prosperous totalitarian state, enforce policies, and lead your troops into first-person battles that grow from desperate skirmishes into large-scale mechanized war.

Dictate wisely. Every choice shapes society, for better or worse.

Mold your citizens through fear, propaganda, surveillance, punishment or rule as a benevolent leader through comfort and prosperity.

While they work for the State, they may grow grateful, afraid, loyal, or quietly rebellious, until dissent becomes revolt.

Venture into the fractured territories of the Tyris System to gather resources, conscript new citizens, trade with wandering merchants, and feed the growth of your colony.

Fight beside your troops in roguelite FPS battles, from hostile ships to large-scale mechanized battlefields of infantry, tanks, and mechs, spreading your doctrine and eliminating threats to humanity.

Weakened foes can be captured and dragged back to your base.

Behind prison doors, resistance can be crushed through fear, indoctrination, execution, or conversion, until an enemy becomes a citizen, a warning to would-be rebels, or another tool of the regime.

Elite enemies, bosses, and Sector Overlords flood the battlefield with bullets, lasers, missiles, drones, artillery, and overlapping projectile patterns.

This is war at scale, but you are not alone. Order your troops to secure victory, or use them as expendable shields to achieve your ends.

Turn a handful of survivors into a vast, tightly run, self-sustaining colony.

Assign citizens to mine, gather, haul, research, and manufacture weapons, armor, food, and supplies. Watch fragile shelters become the machinery of the State.

Collect roguelite cores during each expedition to grow stronger, survive longer, and push deeper into enemy territory.

Weapon Cores reshape how your guns handle. Combination Cores create synergies between different core sets. Others strengthen the troops fighting beside you, or turn them into sacrificial shields for your survival.

Each run becomes a shifting war machine built around you, your squad, and the chaos you unleash together.

Pax Autocratica is a totalitarian colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid that combines base building, citizen management, and first-person chaotic battlefields filled with infantry, vehicles and bullet hell. It offers a dynamic, accessible, and approachable gameplay experience for all in a sci-fi dystopian world.

It’s a game about power. How it’s built, how it corrupts, and how it consumes.

You will command armies, dictate laws, and witness consequences in every face that salutes you or fears you.

THE STATE OBSERVES ALL

How will history remember your reign?

WARNING

This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

data.about_the_game:
Operating directly under the National Command Authority, a relatively unknown entity of handpicked warriors are selected when it is crucial that a mission must not fail. They are the Tier 1 Operators. There are over 2 million active soldiers. Of those, approximately 50 thousand fall under the direct control of the Special Operations Command. The Tier 1 Operator functions on a level above and beyond even the most highly trained Special Operations Forces. Their exact numbers, while classified, hover in the low hundreds. They are living, breathing, precision instruments of war. They are experts in the application of violence. The new Medal of Honor™ is inspired by and developed with actual Tier 1 Operators from this elite community. Players step into the boots of these warriors and apply their unique skill sets to fight a new enemy in the most unforgiving and hostile conditions of present day Afghanistan.

This is a new war. There is a new warrior. He is Tier 1.

  • Fight Today's War: Elite Special Forces in a gritty combat campaign using the surgical tactics of Tier 1 Operators combined with the sledgehammer force of Army Rangers.

  • Unparalleled Authenticity: Intense story with incredible pacing and variety set in the rugged Afghanistan landscape, creating a shooter experience only available from the storied Medal of Honor franchise.

Note: Single-Player only

data.about_the_game:
Assemble a roster of heroes, build out your squad to face any scenario, learn how their skills interact for even greater strategic synergy and master the battlefield:

  • With more than 20+ playable heroes, each with two talent branches and a pool of 25 skills, there are a variety of strategies to approach each battle.

  • Up to 5 heroes can fill your roster from 8 class types: Ranged DPS, Magic Support, Assassins and more.

  • Each skill has it's own unique characteristics. Equip the ones that best suit your play style and create powerful synergistic combos between skills and across your squad.

  • Equip you characters with greater equipment as you progress and upgrade it all at your base with resources you get from missions.

Assume the role of Soren, an retired warrior, now living as a blacksmith, who will mark the steps of a great revolution following an attack on his family:

  • Engage in turn-based tactical battle with several enemy factions. Across a grid-based field, maneuver your squad and the enemy to optimize your strategy and dominate.

  • Every battlefield is different; from using higher ground to increase your attack, to navigating moving environments. Consider your surroundings and use the battlefield to your advantage.

  • Each mission will have a special challenge, pushing your knowledge of the mechanics with even greater rewards if you succeed.

Prelude Dark Pain takes place in the world of Statera, a territory ravaged by the Dark Pain, an ancient and mysterious source of destruction. The Order of the Ashen Crusade rules with blood and terror over a great extent of this territory while praying to the Lord of Pain. However, there are still free people who fight against the lurking evil, like Soren and the Blue Net faction.

The reality of Statera is being torn apart by the conflict, causing tears in the veil between worlds that protects it from supernatural forces. Through these rifts, the creatures of Pain can break through their reality to invade and cause even greater devastation.

Players will have to make important decisions that will influence both the main story and the heroes that can be recruited in battle. You may miss some of them because of your previous choices!

There will be more than 20 different factions with their own cultures scattered throughout Statera. Many of them are hostile, guaranteeing more than 70 different enemies to face. You'll also find final bosses among them!

In addition to the main story, Prelude Dark Pain will be loaded with sidequests and ways to influence the world outside of the main story. These will give you access to recruit certain heroes and even more lore:

  • World Missions can be picked up from NPC's across the world map and lead you to even more content.

  • Raids can undertaken by heroes from your settlement, helping to push back against the tide of enemies, save the innocent, spy and gather resources.

  • Craft new weapons and equipment for your heroes from your settlement as well, taking your skills warriors to an even greater degree of strength.

Powered by Football™, EA SPORTS™ FIFA 22 brings the game even closer to the real thing with fundamental gameplay advances and a new season of innovation across every mode.

What is FIFA?

Play The World’s Game with 17,000+ players, over 700 teams in 90+ stadiums and more than 30 leagues from all over the globe.

GAME MODES
  • Career Mode – Live out your dreams as both a manager and a player in FIFA 22. Create the newest club in FIFA, design your kits, style your stadium, and choose whether to compete with the elite or rise up from the lower divisions as you manage your club to glory. Or test your skills as a player, with a more immersive Player Career mode that gives you more ways to progress, achieve, and immerse yourself in your Pro’s journey through the game.

  • VOLTA FOOTBALL – Take it back to the streets with VOLTA FOOTBALL. Build a player, pick your gear, and express your style on the streets alone or with your squad in football playgrounds all around the world. Get rewarded for your skill on the ball with restyled gameplay, and play unique events in special locations each season as you unlock new gear through a new seasonal progression system that lets you earn XP towards all of the rewards on offer in VOLTA FOOTBALL, whichever mode you play.

  • FIFA Ultimate Team – Get involved with the most popular mode in FIFA, FIFA Ultimate Team. Build your dream squad from thousands of players from across the world of football, make your club your own on and off the pitch with custom kits, badges, and a whole FUT Stadium to leave your mark on, and take your team into matches against the AI or other players in the FUT Community. Plus, welcome back some of the game’s most memorable players as new FUT Heroes, as some of football’s most memorable players return to the pitch.

  • Unrivaled Authenticity – Play with the world’s biggest players in the world’s biggest competitions, including the iconic UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League, brand new UEFA Europa Conference League, CONMEBOL Libertadores, CONMEBOL Sudamericana, Premier League, Bundesliga, LaLiga Santander, and many more!

    When playing FIFA 22 on Steam, you can use your DUALSHOCK 4 and Xbox controllers to play your way.


    This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

data.about_the_game:
Run the league one decision at a time. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine, transforms Franchise into a reactive, always-evolving league where every NFL athlete has a distinct, realistic personality that informs their motivations, demands and reactions. Gameplay gets physical with more precise control from authentic WR/DB battles, new short-yardage mechanics, defensive coverage improvements and new strategic pre-play settings and controls. Build your NFL legacy on a deeper progression path in the new Superstar G.O.A.T. Career Journey and control your roster with more customization with Ultimate Team Captains.

FRANCHISE

The all-new Persona Engine gives every NFL athlete a distinct personality that informs their motivations, how they think and how they respond, transforming your Franchise into a reactive ever-evolving league shaped by every move you make.

GAMEPLAY

Authentic NFL Physicality

Every snap is a battle for control. All-new WR/DB interactions bring true NFL physicality to every route, with realistic hand-fighting, jostling, and leverage that define separation and coverage. Win tight 50-50 moments with timing-based catching and refined contested interactions, or take command in critical situations with improved short-yardage mechanics and plays like the “Tush Push” that decide games when inches matter most.

Gameplanning & Customization

Own every decision before and after the snap. New gameplan adjustments let you preconfigure how your team aligns and reacts, while streamlined pre-play controls put every adjustment at your fingertips. Smarter receiver logic keeps plays alive, while advanced coverage systems and plaster logic help defenses adapt in real time giving you total control to execute your strategy on every snap.

SUPERSTAR

Become the greatest NFL Superstar of all time through an expanded G.O.A.T. Career Journey. Progress from high school to the Hall of Fame with deeper skill trees, new playable positions and unlock meaningful career choices as your legacy grows.

ULTIMATE TEAM


PRESENTATION

The sights and sounds of NFL Sundays bring expanded stadium traditions and broadcast moments to frame the storylines of every game day. From Denver’s pregame skydivers to Jaxson de Ville’s zip line in Jacksonville, new intros, drone shows, and holiday broadcast packages elevate every matchup to big-game energy.

DYNAMIC WEATHER

Dynamic Weather can disrupt your strategy as you face evolving conditions throughout a game. A sunny kickoff in Tampa Bay might turn into a third‑quarter downpour before clearing again. Field degradation makes turf progressively tougher to play on, impacting player movement, stamina, ball security and strategy.

STEINS;GATE Returns! Rebooted for the modern era!

Updated visuals, refined UI, and a revitalized story!

STEINS;GATE follows a ragtag group of tech-savvy students led by Rintaro Okabe, whose latest invention accidentally gains the ability to send messages to the past, unleashing the power to alter history itself.

As global conspiracies stir and timelines begin to twist, the curtain rises on a future steeped in chaos.

---

Characters, artwork, and the user interface have been completely refreshed in this reboot, while an original new scenario expands the world's story. Akihabara has been recreated with stunning realism and depth, drawing you deeper than ever into its streets and secrets.

Character designer huke returns with redesigned outfits and accessories that bring a contemporary flair to the cast. The cityscape has been meticulously reconstructed using authentic references from the era, adding new layers of nostalgic immersion.

With brand-new scenarios and optimized systems, both newcomers and longtime fans can experience STEINS;GATE like never before, a true reboot of the legendary story of time and fate.

Gameplay Features:

  • Your choices shape the fate of the characters and the world itself! Featuring multiple endings that branch based on your decisions.

  • A text-based adventure where controlling Rintaro’s phone can alter the course of destiny.

  • Beautifully remastered visuals rebuilt in stunning high detail.

  • Playtime: Approximately 30–50 hours.

data.about_the_game:
A co-op seance communications game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others.
Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading.
Guide them through a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise.
Can you banish the demon on each floor and reach the bottom of the house?
2-6 players. Brain required.

  • One of you starts dead. Each game, one player becomes the ghost — able to see the demon, the dangers, and the way out, but unable to be heard by the living. Ghosts can hear the living, and each other (ghosts can hear other players, but cannot be heard by non-ghosts.)
    As the ghost, you can see everything — the thing hunting the others, where it's safe, the way out before sunrise. The catch: you can't be heard by the living, you can't touch anything, and your only voice is some flickering lights and a seance board that your friends half-believe is even you.

  • The Ouija board is one of the only voices of the dead. The ghost moves the planchette to point, answer yes or no, or slowly spell things out — and the living will attempt to question them and read it under pressure.

  • A different demon every time. Its rules are hidden and change each session. Only the dead find out what they are, when they strike, and where. The ghosts can see the danger before it hits. They must communicate it with the living and help them banish the demon so they can leave the house before sunrise.

  • Gather the relics, one trip at a time. The ghosts search the house for what the ritual needs, then attempt to communicate it to the living, who will then be carrying each piece back while the ghost steers them around what they can't see and what will kill them. Only the ghost can see what and where the relics are, and only the ghost can see the dangers.

  • You're a ghost. Do ghost things. The ghosts can flicker lights, open and close doors, go through the living and they'll feel it, and as a last resort: scream, loudly -- and if you're all silent enough, you may just hear it. The seance board is not the only way to communicate, but is the only stable way to get full words across to the living.

  • Banish the demon by name. Winning means spelling out its true name — readable only to the dead once all the relics are collected, then the living must spell it back — so you can banish the demon and get everyone out before sunrise. For example, you and your friends will be spelling ULALULA on the board like crazy people to win the game (and pray that you read it right from the ghost player in the first place!).

  • Dying lets you help. Players the demon takes join the dead, adding another voice to the seance, and more help at finding the relics and warning players of the dangers. 

  • Nine floors down. The house is bigger underneath. Banish the demon to unlock the next floor, each further from sunrise than the last, and each one holding something the floor above it didn't. Can you and your friends reach the bottom of the house and beat floor 9?

  • 2-6 players online co-op.
    You spell H-E-L-P. They read HELL and cheer. Someone gets dragged into the dark. To survive the night, the living will have to haul the right relics back to the seance board and spell out the demon's true name to banish it — and the dead are the only ones who can read that name.

It only takes one friend who listens to the dead to save everyone. You do not have that friend.

Smash through the streets of Nuevo-Tokyo in a fast chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up where every run unlocks new powers, builds and ridiculous Mexican Jutsus.

Our story takes place in Nuevo-Tokyo, an offspring of chaos that was born when Japan and Mexico collided in fire, power and betrayal.

A land where a new feudal regime was forged between Narcos and Yakuzas, forming a new ruling class, The Narkuzas.

They are now the law, and the law SUCKS CULO.

Now, in the outskirts of Nuevo-Tokyo, a group of rebels is plotting against the five heads of the Narkuza clan.

Enter the Mexican Ninja…

Pela el oido, I’m going to tell you a story, eh? One full of adrenaline-pumping combat, where the streets never give you a break, no matter how many fall before you.

  • Explore the stylized streets of Nuevo Tokyo, a city where Narcos and Yakuzas joined forces and mi pueblo was never the same.

  • Precise movement, positioning and perfectly timed attacks decide every fight.

  • It’s a pick-up-and-play brawler that’s deceptively simple, yet deeply rewarding once you start mastering combos and builds.

  • Unlock ninja skills by training with el Mero Mero Sensei.

  • Gain the favor of powerful Mexican-Japanese spirits and unleash their powers throughout your runs.

  • Experiment with different builds, discover devastating combos and carve your own fighting style.

  • Customize your character with hidden outfits and swag worthy of a true cabrón.

Mexican Ninja is a return to the button-mashing arcade classics, but with roguelike chaos and modern depth. 

Fight your way through gangs of Narkuzas, master outrageous Mexican Jutsus and leave a trail of broken enemies behind you.

Because when we fight… we do it CON HUEVOS CABRON.

Customize your fighting style using our Way of the Donkey tree. The Way of the Donkey is our skill tree, except it’s 10x cooler and made for people with peluche en el estuche.

There’s an inner cabrón in all of us. Be THE Mexican Ninja and show the Narkuzas the true way of the blade.

Testimonials

"I couldn’t be prouder of what the whole Amber team has helped us build and bring to life through this video game. In my culture, a HERO was always needed… ****, it still is… Mexican Ninja has always been about that to me - the longing for that idea. Having profound admiration for Japanese culture, its history, and its roots, it naturally seemed like the perfect one to blend and contrast with my own. I hope players can join the fun, explore the world, and embrace all the quirks of this concept. I hope they get their asses kicked and stand up again, and again, and again—and through this dynamic, understand that Mexican Ninja is a vibe, a spirit, a way of being. I wish you a good journey in finding your inner donkey. Stay blazed"
Carlos Rincones

"No notes. Seems good."
Chris Zukowski

data.about_the_game:
Run the league one decision at a time. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine, transforms Franchise into a reactive, always-evolving league where every NFL athlete has a distinct, realistic personality that informs their motivations, demands and reactions. Gameplay gets physical with more precise control from authentic WR/DB battles, new short-yardage mechanics, defensive coverage improvements and new strategic pre-play settings and controls. Build your NFL legacy on a deeper progression path in the new Superstar G.O.A.T. Career Journey and control your roster with more customization with Ultimate Team Captains.

FRANCHISE

The all-new Persona Engine gives every NFL athlete a distinct personality that informs their motivations, how they think and how they respond, transforming your Franchise into a reactive ever-evolving league shaped by every move you make.

GAMEPLAY

Authentic NFL Physicality

Every snap is a battle for control. All-new WR/DB interactions bring true NFL physicality to every route, with realistic hand-fighting, jostling, and leverage that define separation and coverage. Win tight 50-50 moments with timing-based catching and refined contested interactions, or take command in critical situations with improved short-yardage mechanics and plays like the “Tush Push” that decide games when inches matter most.

Gameplanning & Customization

Own every decision before and after the snap. New gameplan adjustments let you preconfigure how your team aligns and reacts, while streamlined pre-play controls put every adjustment at your fingertips. Smarter receiver logic keeps plays alive, while advanced coverage systems and plaster logic help defenses adapt in real time giving you total control to execute your strategy on every snap.

SUPERSTAR

Become the greatest NFL Superstar of all time through an expanded G.O.A.T. Career Journey. Progress from high school to the Hall of Fame with deeper skill trees, new playable positions and unlock meaningful career choices as your legacy grows.

ULTIMATE TEAM


PRESENTATION

The sights and sounds of NFL Sundays bring expanded stadium traditions and broadcast moments to frame the storylines of every game day. From Denver’s pregame skydivers to Jaxson de Ville’s zip line in Jacksonville, new intros, drone shows, and holiday broadcast packages elevate every matchup to big-game energy.

DYNAMIC WEATHER

Dynamic Weather can disrupt your strategy as you face evolving conditions throughout a game. A sunny kickoff in Tampa Bay might turn into a third‑quarter downpour before clearing again. Field degradation makes turf progressively tougher to play on, impacting player movement, stamina, ball security and strategy.

• Wordless point-and-click adventure — no dialogue, no subtitles, just animation, sound, and visual storytelling.

  • An unlikely friendship in a hostile world — a wordless story of bravery, trust, and survival.

  • Brains over brawn — outsmart dinosaurs, distract barbarians, and puzzle your way out of deadly situations.

  • A vivid prehistoric world — trek through jungles, valleys, canyons, caves, and wild dinosaur territory.

  • Gorgeous hand-drawn pixel art brought to life with cinematic frame-by-frame animation.

  • An immersive soundtrack blending tribal rhythms with eerie sci-fi synthesizers.

A glowing stone crashes from the sky into a young hunter’s village. Its arrival draws a bloodthirsty tribe, who attack the settlement and enslave her people.

Barely escaping into the jungle, she discovers the stone’s true origin: a stranded spaceman whose damaged pod depends on it.

Together, this unlikely pair must cross dinosaur-infested lands to free her tribe and find a way to send him home.


Theropods is a classic point-and-click adventure built around visual logic. Watch how characters move, how creatures behave, and how each scene changes as you poke, prod, and experiment.

Instead of fighting your way through danger, you solve your way through it — distracting predators, avoiding enemies, triggering reactions, and finding clever ways past situations too dangerous to face head-on.

Theropods replaces dialogue trees, long conversations, and text walls with gestures, expressions, sound, and visual storytelling. The story unfolds through action: what characters do, what they notice, and what changes around them.

With no subtitles or text-heavy exposition to translate, the adventure is built to be understood by players anywhere in the world.

data.about_the_game:
Space Tales is a story-driven sci-fi real-time strategy game where humanity’s expansion into the stars has awakened ancient races and universe-ending threats far beyond its control.

You play as Xander Falcon, a young commander shaped by family tragedy and thrown into a war no one fully understands. Under the banner of the I.P.E., humanity’s Inter-Planetary Expansion army, you will build colonies on hostile alien worlds, command retro-futuristic forces, and uncover the truth behind a conflict that reaches far deeper than the battlefield.

Every mission pushes you to think fast and plan ahead. Expand your base with the HUB system, manage limited resources, secure power lines, and fortify your colony before the next wave hits.

Scout ahead, position your units, protect your base, and react quickly when the battlefield changes. The best commanders read the threat, adapt their plan, and seize the advantage.

If you love RTS games where choices matter, Space Tales gives you plenty to master: resource management, base expansion, unit control, defensive planning, and a complex tech tree for your unit and the defense HUB system.

Face three enemy factions with very different combat styles.

The Kill Bots bring relentless mechanized pressure, forcing you to rethink your unit composition and push beyond the safety of your base. The Necroborg escalate the conflict even further, challenging everything you have learned with fortified defenses, perfectly timed attacks, and a threat that grows stronger the longer you leave it unchecked.

What works against one faction may fail completely against another. To survive, you will need to adapt your defenses, unit composition, and battlefield decisions from one mission to the next.


Massive boss encounters test your timing, positioning, and unit control. Study their attack patterns, choose your moment to engage, and strike carefully: these enemies are too dangerous to brute-force, and they cannot be captured.

Beyond boss fights, the battlefield is also home to powerful neutral monsters. Defeat and capture them, then summon them as battlefield allies to break enemy lines, defend your colony, and change the course of battle.

Space Tales blends tactical warfare with a character-driven sci-fi story where personal loyalty, propaganda, imperial ambition, and cosmic horror collide.

As Xander fights alongside Vespera, a sharp mission coordinator, and Desmond, a loyal recruit, each mission uncovers new questions about humanity’s place among the stars. Every battle draws them deeper into the mystery, revealing more about the war, their allies, and the future they are fighting for.

From fragile first outposts to full-scale planetary assaults, the campaign pushes Xander and his forces through desperate defenses, hostile frontlines, and tactical turning points where every decision can change the course of the mission.

The galaxy is hostile. Your resources are limited. Your enemies do not fight fair. This is Space Tales!

Features

  • Story-driven RTS campaign - Lead Xander Falcon through a full sci-fi RTS campaign shaped by family tragedy, ancient races, hostile worlds, and universe-ending threats.

  • Replayable survival challenges - Survival maps throw you into escalating battles where the goal is simple: endure, adapt, and see how far your colony can hold before the enemy overwhelms you.

  • Modular HUB-based base building - Expand your colony through the HUB system, secure energy lines, connect key structures, and turn fragile outposts into fortified war machines.

  • Deep tech tree - Upgrade your HUB system and units through branching tech paths, customizing your army to match your strategy from one mission to the next.

  • Three enemy factions to outthink - Face distinct enemy factions with different combat behaviors, forcing you to adapt your defenses, attack tactics, unit choices, and timing from one battle to the next.

  • Boss fights and monster allies - Study the attack patterns of colossal bosses, engage carefully, and capture powerful neutral monsters that can be summoned to break enemy lines and support your army.

  • RTS depth and player control - Manage resources, unlock upgrades, command retro-futuristic units, and master the balance between expansion, defense, and decisive counterattacks

Grim Trials is a heavy metal action roguelite where you craft and customize your own weapons and equipment to embrace Death your own way.

Play as Avelin, a young woman who has met an untimely end, and found herself recruited as one of Death’s many Reapers. Tasked to hunt down impure souls, face her demons, and fight her way through an underworld of her own making, Avelin must endure these trials to become a full-fledged Reaper and see her still-living love once again.

Endless hex-grid arenas filled with monsters, traps, sinful souls, and 7 sacrilegious bosses await. Slay them all with a variety of customizable scythes, crossbows, and powerful Blessings from the Gods of Death around the world. Master the scythe and crossbow to maximize damage to your foes with a unique combat system that rewards clever use of your dual-wielded weapons.

The spoils of battle are the tools of your trade. Gather materials from the battlefield and work with your mentors in the arcane arts to craft new and ever more powerful weapons, armor, and consumables.

Every reaper carves their own path! Mix and match your crafted equipment with skills gained from investing in an expansive skill tree at the start of every run, then choose carefully from the randomized Blessings you obtain mid-run to create powerful builds!

Explore The Academy, built for the training and arming of Death’s various Reapers. Seek enlightenment from mentors, take on quests to build your relationships, and unlock sage advice, knowledge, and powerful support from your peers. Learn the stories of the dead by interacting with the Academy’s denizens.

Coming of age in the afterlife was certainly not the plan, but dying means little to the already-dead, and love unyielding wields power no god can rival. Every time Avelin falls in battle, the experience and materials you’ve earned stay with her. Live, fight, die, then live again, over and over until the promise is kept.

PengPong is a bullet-hell roguelike where your only hope for survival is to bounce weapons, items, and... well, pretty much anything that moves. Remember: if it’s not bouncing, you’re doing it wrong. Bounce hard, bounce well, and don’t stop.

Key Features:

  • Survive the Chaos: Master an endless array of character and weapon combinations to be the last penguin standing.

  • Physics is Your Weapon: Forget direct hits; momentum and angles are everything. Bounce hockey pucks, guns (yes, you throw them), earphones (this one too), and even pufferfish! If it doesn’t hit them the first time, just keep bouncing it until it does.

  • High Stakes, High Rewards: Every wave ends with a choice. Will you sign a brutal contract, go all-in at the gambling den, or play it safe at the shop? The choice is yours.

  • Infinite Synergy: With over 300+ items, every run creates a unique whirlwind of possibilities and chaotic variables.

  • Rise to the Top: Compete with players worldwide and prove your skills on the global leaderboard.

  • Cute but Creepy: Immerse yourself in a world inspired by vintage animation; where "adorable" meets "disturbing."

Hit the jackpot in our gambling mini-games and watch the difficulty melt away! But don’t get us wrong, PengPong isn’t a gambling simulator. It’s just a friendly, neighbourhood bullet-hell roguelike starring a very cute penguin, and its even cuter friends. Mostly.

Synopsis:

The Moon was shattered. A mysterious impact knocked it off course, and now it's on a slow, inevitable collision with Earth. Humanity's last hope lies in three massive colony ships bound for the closest thing to a new Earth, Proxima B.

You play as Sister Zola, a nun, psychiatrist, and high-ranking officer, tasked with protecting the minds of the colonists during their long cryosleep. But hyperspace, as you will soon discover, is not empty, for some devils have found their way through.

When the Argos jumps into the unknown, reality fractures. The crew loses their minds or their souls. Some awaken changed, twisted into nightmare beings. Rogue machines stalk the corridors. The ship itself becomes a hostile, ever-shifting maze.

Armed with faith, newfound powers, and your precious staff, you must fight your way through the shattered halls of Argos. Save who you can. Destroy what you must. And pray that, in the abyss of hyperspace, you don't lose your soul too.

Key Features:

  • Tactical Combat: Every encounter demands thought. Cooldowns govern your abilities, positioning determines survival, and timing separates victory from failure. Each confrontation requires careful consideration of when to strike, where to stand, and how to react. 

  • Narrative-Driven Exploration: The Argos was meant to carry humanity to safety. Now its corridors echo with madness and whispers from the void. Piece together what happened when the ship entered hyperspace through scattered logs, twisted crew testimonies, and signs that defy explanation. As Sister Zola, uncover the truth behind the corruption that has taken hold, and face impossible choices about who can still be saved and who is beyond redemption. Your decisions shape both the story's outcome and the ship's fate.

  • Build Flexibility: Your abilities adapt to your approach. Channel Zola's powers through devastating spells, hone your skills in close combat, or perfect ranged precision. No rigid classes, so you can shift between styles as the situation demands or the story unfolds.

  • Haunting Atmosphere: The ship itself tells the story: flickering lights reveal traces of struggle, distant echoes hint at unseen horrors, and corrupted transmissions bleed through the silence. Every sound and shadow contributes to the unraveling mystery of what hyperspace has done to the Argos and its inhabitants.

  • Streamlined Experience: No cluttered menus or resource management to break the tension. 2nd EVE keeps the interface minimal and purposeful, stripping away inventory screens so nothing pulls you out of the moment. The story lives in the environment itself, told through the ship's decaying corridors, scattered crew logs, and the silent evidence of what ARGOS has done to the people left behind. When the horror speaks, you are already inside it.

data.about_the_game:
Repterra is a base-building survival RTS set in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Manage your colony while battling massive dino hordes. Breed and ride your own dinos, unlock permanent upgrades, and fight to reclaim the world for humanity.

Massive Colonies

Building a massive colony is essential. Construct sprawling defences, set up vast production lines, and establish powerful grids to fuel your outposts. Each structure adds strength as you prepare to face relentless dinosaur swarms.

Dino Riding

Assign human units (soldier, engineer, tamer) to one of your dinos and let them ride! Each human/dino combination has powerful and unique special abilities.

Breeding

Put a male/female pair of dinos in your breeding station and let nature do its thing! The offspring may surprise you. Crossbreeding with genetic mutations is encouraged.

Taming

Lure in enemy dinosaurs with food, distractions, or sex. Once tamed, they will fight alongside you.

Hero Units

Upgradeable hero units have special active and passive abilities, and will respawn when killed. Level up your hero and customize him with genetic mutations.

Factions

3 factions, each with unique units, perks, and heroes. Every faction emphasizes a different play style, from resource management and mobility to technology, dinosaur taming, or raw combat power. Choose the one that fits your strategy and conquer accordingly.

Story

In 1963, explorers uncovered an uncharted island in the Indian Ocean, hidden by a magnetic anomaly and inhabited by living dinosaurs from the Triassic period. Despite restrictions, poachers smuggled these creatures to sell to the wealthy, who kept them as exotic pets. Confinement led the dinosaurs to become aggressive, resulting in escapes that were suppressed by influential elites.

By the 1990s, escaped dinosaurs multiplied uncontrollably. Millions roamed the planet, devastating human populations and infrastructure, turning vast regions into uninhabitable wastelands and collapsing global supply chains.

Now, humanity faces the daunting task of reclaiming these lost territories. As part of a specialized team, your mission is to control the rampant dinosaur populations and pave the way for humans to rebuild and resettle. The future of civilization is in your hands.

Features

  • Unique Breeding, Riding, and Taming mechanics.

  • 3 Different factions with unique play-style focuses

  • Game-modifying perks that can be chosen at load-out

  • Permanent unlockable points and shop (levels, perks, bonus features)

  • Customizable hero units.

  • 7 highly replayable maps with unlockables and meta progression

  • 100,000+ dinos running at a smooth 60fps

  • Dozens of different units, dinos, and buildings

  • Achievements and Steam Cloud

  • 4k High resolution graphic in a timeless pre-rendered style

Reclaim our overrun planet and use dino technology against them!

Cozy Marbles is a comfy game about building marble runs. Using a huge range of bits and pieces from charming homes, fairytale realms and starlit spacecraft, fit together the marble course you’ve always wanted to build and play with. Unwind to a bespoke lo-fi soundtrack and roll with the nostalgia.

Tinker with freeform construction tools and a rich library of parts. Design awesome spirals, twists and drops, then roll your marbles off on their adventure. Take “playing with marbles” to a whole new level by guiding them across complex courses, bouncing over obstacles with boosters, ramps and cannons, floating dreamily through anti-gravity fields, and even making music with xylophone blocks.

Play in a range of environments with themed parts:

  • A mellow Living Room, in daylight or at night.

  • A whimsical Fairytale Tavern, the perfect place to build a castle coaster or labyrinthine mushroom forest.

  • A mesmerizing Space Station for high-tech futurism including portals and laser tunnels.

Build your marble run from wood, metal or plastic, choose its colors and give it a name. Customize your marbles with a range of colors, patterns, national flags, facial expressions, stylish hats and silly little arms that flail while rolling. Beat challenges to unlock even more customization options, track pieces and environments.

Cozy Marbles is a little game with a big brain. Plan and experiment with all sorts of marble constructs, from marble rollercoasters to wacky apparatus. Watch your marbles flow through carefully laid routes… or fly way off track!

Assemble a marble course, drop your marbles and watch them race to the end. Use checkpoints to split the track or set up multiple start and finish lines wherever you want. Make your race sweet and simple, or huge and complex with tons of laps and hundreds of marbles! May the best one win.

The next step after perfecting your marble masterpiece (or diabolical marble trap) is to share it with the world. Export and import courses to show off your build and try everyone else’s. If you’re a streamer, use Twitch integration to let Twitch Chat drop marbles into your course and join your race!

We think you'll love Cozy Marbles if you enjoy...

Marbles on Stream, Marble World, Tiny Glade, Satisfactory, House Flipper 2, Small Spaces, PowerWash Simulator 2, Islands & Trains, Tiny Book Shop, Supermarket Simulator, Sticky Business, A Little To The Left, Rollercoaster Tycoon, Hozy.

data.about_the_game:
A survival horror in Lovecraft's world

The Sinking City 2 is a third-person survival horror set in 1920s Arkham. Deliberate, tense, and resource-lean: pressure builds as you push deeper, relief comes in brief refuge, and fear is something you manage. Mind your inventory, take on unnerving puzzles, and double back via unlocked shortcuts for supplies and upgrades.

Arkham, New England

A Roaring ’20s port city buckling under a supernatural flood. Tide-stained avenues and battered Art Deco. Speakeasies gone dark. Districts feel lived-in and water-worn, with routes by foot and skiff, shortcuts behind collapsed seawalls, and secrets tucked in boarded parlors. You’ll navigate a hospital where science hides its face, a fish market where the merchandise bites back, and descend deep below the city to where eldritch horrors stir.

A rescue with impossible stakes

A ritual gone wrong trapped her soul in the Dreamlands, and now malevolent forces have stolen her body. To rescue the woman you love, you must walk a dangerous path through catastrophe to the source of the flood — her presence always felt, but rarely seen.

Fearsome foes

The Slither animate the dead. Deep Ones surge from dark water. Shadows bend space and test nerves. Some fights must be met head-on; others demand a retreat to rearm, retune your build, and return better prepared. Or take on an optional investigation and come back with an upgraded gun.

Investigate at will

Exploration is the key to survival. Read ritual residues, sift through grisly clues, decode journals that shouldn’t exist, and pry at masks that won’t come off. Optional cases never gate progress — but they unlock safer routes, hard supplies, and upgrades that change how you endure the next encounter.

Built with uncommon devotion

The Sinking City 2 draws on Frogwares’ detective roots to deliver survival horror that runs deep and hits hard. Shaped by studio obsession and community feedback, it’s a faithful Lovecraft experience: myths made manifest, and the inconceivable fear that results.

Ascend the Tower, a labyrinth sunken to the depths of the earth, and escape to the surface.

Food is of great worth within the labyrinth, so be sure to collect whatever you find.

Even the slightest misstep can soil your soul, and once corruption reaches its limit you'll be swallowed up by a game over.
Chaos is always watching for an opening within the Tower. Beware, for this may be the greatest threat of all.

The story has multiple endings, and with New Game Plus, each run can further enhance the hero.
Every attempt and challenge will bring you one step closer to your final destination―the surface.

data.about_the_game:
It's a Shipper's biggest fear. You're grounded in the exclusion zone, twenty miles of death and decay sealed off by the towering, suffocating walls erected after the collapse.

Alone, stranded, and with limited resources at your disposal you'll have to push your way through the zone, solve environmental puzzles, manage resources and fight for your life as you try to find a way to escape beyond the wall.




Play as Mica, an unlicensed black market shipper who will stop at nothing to find her missing partner.

It’s been 12 days since Sasha left.

You talked about it, you argued about it and you even laughed about it. Anybody in their right mind knew going to that place was a death wish, a one-way trip to the end of the line. But Sasha wasn’t one to scare easily, she wanted answers and there was only one place those answers held any truth. Her mind was already made up, you just didn’t expect her to do it without you.

Twelve sleepless nights later and you finally get the call. Tax has found someone, A border security suit looking to make some extra credits on the down-low. He can get you clearance, a two hour window to fly into the zone, find Sasha and get the hell out of there.

You make your way across the exclusion zone but something’s wrong. The nav's running in circles and you're losing altitude. Before you know it a blinding white fills the sky. The dash goes dark and your hover drops out of the air like a lead balloon, slamming into the paved streets below.



You wake to the acrid smell of an electrical fire, rain pounding on the cracked windshield. You're surrounded by the crumbling remains of what were once considered homes.

You need to find a way out. Call for evac, scale the walls. Something. Anything. Survive.

FEATURES:


  • Classic survival horror gameplay inspired by early 2000s horror titles.

  • Cinematic blend of dynamic and fixed camera angles.

  • Logic puzzles, resource management and limited combat with a focus on narrative and exploration.

  • Full voice acting.

  • An emphasis on strong world building set in a dystopian near-future.

  • Carefully paced save points ensure tension is maintained whilst respecting the player's time.

  • Difficulty options to aid players who prefer exploration over combat.

  • Post-game unlocks and features.

data.about_the_game:
49 Keys is a narrative-focused game that will test your wits and nerves. Peruse the pages of a Lovecraftian tale, interact with maps and solve the puzzles encountered along the way. Trace your master's footsteps to uncover the deepest secrets of the arcane, on a quest brimming with horror and magic.

Embark on a Disturbing Journey

Alas, I knew not of the extraordinary, bizarre, and gut-churning sights that awaited within those walls.

The year is 1520. You receive a letter from your old mentor, the first step on an unnerving journey like none before. One that shall expose you to the forbidden arcane and all its mystery in which you shall concoct mixtures both wondrous and strange, and summon forth beings of other-worldly power. You must steel yourself, for terrors buried deep within shall soon awaken within you, Dantean horrors that bleed into reality. Endure these trials and, in time, the truth shall draw near. Yet will you be brave enough to pay its price?

An Immersive Literary Feat

Its lauded writing aside, 49 Keys is an audio-visual work of art. Intricately-designed menus hark back to manuscripts of the Middle Ages through to the Renaissance, with a unique art style throughout. Pore over incredible full-colour illustrations, and feel the thrill as original themes perfectly complement each twist and turn. All this combines for a deeply immersive world.

Unique Riddles and Marvellous Mysteries

Akin to point-and-click adventures, 49 Keys has you search through a meticulously-crafted world collecting items to aid you in solving its intricate puzzles. Read every word with care, for vital clues are hidden within. Put your reasoning skills to the test, and push onward; but fear not—an array of detailed in-game tips are at hand, if ever you need them.

Directly Adapted From The Best-Seller

49 Keys was developed and adapted by the original author behind the 2022 gamebook of the same name (49 Chiavi), a best-selling puzzle adventure. Gaining overwhelming praise from critics, it also achieved a place on Italy's 2022 gamebook best-seller list, going on to win two highly-coveted awards that year.

April 14, 1912. The final night of the RMS Titanic.

You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship.

Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger.

And then the iceberg hits.

What was once an investigation becomes a desperate fight for survival as freezing water floods the ship, corridors tilt, lights fail, and panic spreads across the decks. Every choice matters. Every second counts.

The ship will sink.

What you discover — and who you save — is up to you.

KEY FEATURES:

Explore the Titanic Before and During the Disaster

Walk through richly detailed areas of the ship, from luxurious public rooms to restricted service corridors, cargo spaces, machinery areas, and lifeboat decks.

Investigate a Dark Mystery

Search crime scenes, collect evidence, question passengers, and uncover hidden connections before the final night arrives.

Puzzle and Lock Interaction

Solve environmental puzzles, open locked doors, decode clues, and use tools to access restricted areas.

Stealth and Tension

Enter forbidden sections of the ship, avoid dangerous enemies, and uncover secrets others want buried.

Dynamic Sinking Gameplay

Experience rising water, tilting decks, blocked paths, failing lights, and changing environments as Titanic succumbs to the Atlantic.

Survival Mechanics

Manage cold, stamina, blocked routes, and physical hazards while trying to reach safety.

Moral Choices and Multiple Endings

In the final moments, decide what matters most: justice, love, or saving as many lives as possible.

Historical Atmosphere

Meet passengers and crew inspired by real Titanic history, and witness moments of human courage, fear, and sacrifice during the final hours.

Do you have what it takes to survive the most famous shipwreck in history? Or will you become another soul claimed by the icy depths? The clock is ticking. The water is rising. Your decisions will determine your fate.

data.about_the_game:
The world is dead. The state has collapsed. In a forgotten Eastern Bloc town, you are alone but not truly alone. Something stirs beyond the walls, and none of it means you well. You have only one reason to keep going: survive long enough to find your wife, Valeria. But in the cold and darkness of this unforgiving night, will you ever make it back to her? 

In the hellish streets of this Eastern Bloc town, every bullet matters. There are ways to fight back, but survival demands more than firepower. Use the weapons at your disposal to clear a path, scavenge tools to overcome the obstacles ahead, and avoid unnecessary confrontations whenever you can.

Iron Blight aims to deliver an immersive gameplay experience built around atmosphere, vulnerability, and the crushing weight of isolation. Every bullet matters, and the sound of gunfire may draw even more horrors to your position. Even something as simple as opening a locked door demands thought. You must manage your food and medical supplies, move cautiously through the streets, and always consider what might be waiting around the next corner.

  • True Survival Horror Gameplay: Navigate desolate streets and claustrophobic interiors, where danger lurks around every corner. Solve puzzles and face the terrors that will force a choice: fight, flee, or die.

  • Resource Scarcity and Tension: Resources are scarce. Do you risk using your last bullet to take down a monster, or do you save it for a more critical moment and hope to slip past unnoticed?

  • Diegetic Grid-Based Inventory: Every single item matters, and space is a luxury you can't afford. Carefully manage your limited inventory grid, making agonizing choices about what to carry and what to leave behind.

  • No HUD, No Distractions: No health bars, no ammo counters, no intrusive menus. Every piece of information is conveyed through your character and the world around you. Your only interface is your own perception.

  • A Unique Weapon System: Check your magazines manually, round by precious round, and reload with deliberate, step-by-step actions. Every firefight becomes a tense test of your nerves and skill.

  • A Bleak and Oppressive Atmosphere: Rain-slick cobblestones and flickering fluorescent lights lead you deeper into a town that feels cold, hostile, and suffocating. The distant cries of things that should not exist echo through its desolate streets.

  • A Return to Forgotten Horror Traditions: Fear comes from the atmosphere, the gnawing uncertainty, and the constant presence of death. The story is told through the environment itself, and combat is a slow, methodical dance where every shot matters.

data.about_the_game:
Nerd Simulator is a short, humorous point-and-click adventure for one evening. Meet Mervin: he’s forty years old, has no savings, no plans for the future, and a mom who expects rent every single week.

About the Game

Your goal is simple: help Mervin earn enough money to finally move out of his mom’s house. Click everything that can be clicked, talk to the local weirdos, and take on jobs no sensible person would ever put on their résumé.

The road to independence leads through casinos, suspicious cryptocurrencies, and friendships with even shadier characters. Every one of Mervin’s ideas sounds bad, and most of them end even worse.

Sometimes, however, you have to do some honest work. Mow lawns, scrub toilets, sort garbage, and complete other absurd jobs presented as short mini-games.

Short on rent money? Dance at a strip club. Lost everything? Challenge your mom to a fistfight. In Mervin’s life, every problem has a solution – usually a very stupid one.

Between disasters, visit the gym, paint something, or befriend a goldfish. After all, Mervin needs a moment to recover from the consequences of his own decisions.

Wackyngton is not a normal place. You’ll meet over-the-top characters, hear dialogue dripping with dark humor, and experience situations that leave you with only one question: “WTF?!”

What’s Inside?

  • A short, focused point-and-click adventure designed for a single evening

  • A mix of 2D and 3D tasks, Mervin’s interactive room, and his command center – a computer running Doors XD

  • A series of short mini-games inspired by Mervin’s most ridiculous jobs and side hustles

  • Simple management of Mervin’s needs: sleep, hunger, and bladder

  • Room customization and light progression elements

  • Dialogue packed with dark humor and a cast of bizarre, over-the-top characters

  • Additional activities such as working out, painting, and other absurd hobbies

  • A small story-driven comedy interspersed with mini-games

Nerd Simulator is a small game about a big nerd – a short, weird, and unapologetically stupid adventure for one evening.

data.about_the_game:
It's the Stone Age. Humans are not yet apex predators. We are, in fact, quite far down the list. You are a tribe leader. Your job is to take your people from desperate Paleolithic hunter-gatherers to the first permanent settlements of the Neolithic age, laying the foundations for all of human civilization. No pressure.

Along the way, you'll craft the earliest tools in human history, research technologies that separated us from every other species on Earth, build villages, manage a tribe, and navigate a world that is genuinely trying to eat you.

A Low-Poly World of Opportunity

The Polylithic world is vibrant, colorful, and almost entirely indifferent to your survival. Forage for resources across tall forests, snow-dusted hills, and rapids that do not care about your life. Hunt everything from rabbits to mammoths, each one a unique challenge, and each one a reminder that this is, technically, their world too. Seek out other human tribes, or what's left of them, learn from their mistakes, and then don’t do that.

Prehistoric Survival

Gather, craft, hunt, cook, and occasionally yell at wildlife; survival in the Stone Age is a full-time occupation. Master an evolving tech tree, experiment with a cooking system that generates recipes with predictably unpredictable results, and keep your body fed, rested, and functional. You can also tame a dog. Or a hyena. Both are loyal. One is slightly more alarming. Either way, companions eat, heal, follow commands, and will absolutely judge your decision-making

Lay the Foundations of Civilization

Survival alone is one option. The other, the one that actually worked, is forming a tribe. As village leader, you'll manage your tribespeople's needs, grow your settlement, and guide them toward the Neolithic Revolution. They'll work, become Elders, and slowly, improbably, build something that resembles a civilization.

Not everyone will welcome your progress. Enemy tribes have their own ideas about how prehistory should go. Sandbox Mode offers an infinitely generated world for those who prefer to skip the story and cause problems at their own pace. Customize your character (it's the Stone Age, somehow), emote around the campfire, and do your best to make prehistory turn into history.

Survive Together

Bring up to 9 friends into your Stone Age and form your own tribe. Share resources, coordinate hunts, build together, or completely ignore the plan and do your own thing; multiplayer makes every survival story unique, unpredictable, and significantly easier to blame on someone else.

data.about_the_game:
Volkolak: The Will of Gods is a 2D Soulslike Metroidvania in a dark Slavic fantasy setting. The action takes place in the Far-away State, a vast, rich world of medieval times for exploration. After the ominous curse of the necromancer Koschei the Immortal, its inhabitants go mad and turn into evil. The protagonist will have to fight his minions using a deep combat system.

Game Features

  • Classic Metroidvania with side-scrolling 2D action.

  • Traditional 2D frame-by-frame animation in dark style.

  • The game features the mechanics of turning into a werewolf, which is the basis of the gameplay.

  • Choose your class: the path of a bloodthirsty ghoul (Class: Cursed), or control your instincts with magic (Class: Volkolak), or take the path of a warrior (Class: Veteran).

  • In werewolf form, you can gain additional abilities through the altars of pagan gods, and with some mythical creatures you can strike up a dialog and gain valuable information.

  • Play through the game in human form, equipping your character with various weapons.

  • Unique locations, NPCs and story adventures for each class. Three playthrough options and different game endings.

  • Explore a large world inspired by Slavic mythology: the dungeons of Tsargrad, the Dark Forest or the Stinking Swamp.

  • Learn new skills and abilities that will open your way to secret places and unique locations

  • In this dark fairy tale you will meet mythical creatures: Leshy, Serpent, Baba Yaga, Koschey the Immortal, Firebird and many others.

  • Over 50 unique enemies and 10 mythical bosses! Epic battles with mythical creatures await you in this adventure. Unlock the power of ancient gods or use your sacred faith, the choice is yours!

The vast, interconnected world is filled with mysticism, mythical creatures, and mystery.

"Volkolak: The Will of Gods" is a vast world inspired by Slavic mythology and folk tales. A dark fantasy universe as an interpretation of the greatest fears of ancient man. The gloomy atmosphere immerses the player in the unusual perception of Slavic legends as we are not used to see them.

data.about_the_game:
A dark and violent crime thriller set against the backdrop of 1940’s Los Angeles, now in stunning virtual reality.

L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files places you directly in the shoes of Detective Cole Phelps as you solve brutal crimes, plots and conspiracies inspired by real cases from 1947 Los Angeles, one of the most corrupt and violent times in L.A. history.

Featuring seven cases rebuilt specifically for virtual reality, L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files adds new layers of immersion and realism to Rockstar Games’ atmospheric crime thriller as you solve select cases from the blockbuster original game, spanning mysteries from the Detective desks of Traffic, Arson, Homicide, and more.

• Search for clues by grabbing, inspecting and manipulating objects
• Get behind the wheel and drive to your next crime scene
• Engage in chases, fistfights and shootouts as you track down suspects
• Build your case by making notes or drawing freehand in your detective’s notebook
• Interrogate witnesses and use your wits to separate truth from lies in a city where everyone has something to hide

Additional System Specifications

Due to current performance issues with AMD hardware, only specific combinations of AMD and NVIDIA/Intel Hardware will allow the game to play as intended:
• If using an AMD Ryzen 7 CPU, an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (or above) graphics card is required to play
• If using an AMD Vega 56 graphics card, an Intel i7 6700 (or above) CPU is required to play
• Attempting to use an AMD CPU and GPU together to play the game is not supported at this time

L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files only supports a single graphics card architecture; NVIDIA SLI and AMD CrossFire features are not supported.

Over time programming changes will change the system requirements for this game. Please refer to your hardware manufacturer and for current compatibility information. Some system components such as mobile chipsets, integrated, and AGP graphics cards may be incompatible. Unlisted specifications may not be supported by publisher.

Other requirements: Installation and play requires log-in to Rockstar Games Social Club (varies 13+) network; internet connection required for activation and periodic entitlement verification; software installations required including Rockstar Games Social Club platform, DirectX 9, DirectX June 2010 Redistributable Package, Chromium, and Microsoft Visual C++ 2012 and 2015 Redistributable Packages, and authentication software that recognizes certain hardware attributes for entitlement, digital rights management, system, and other support purposes.

Single use serial code registration via internet required; registration is limited to one Rockstar Games Social Club account (varies 13+) per serial code; only one PC log-in allowed per Social Club account at any time; serial code(s) are non-transferable once used; Social Club accounts are non-transferable.

Moo Who? is a multiplayer voice-mimicry party game where animal players hide among NPC herds while hunters try to figure out who is fake.

Sound Like an Animal

Every animal player must use their microphone to mimic their assigned species.

Moo like a cow. Cluck like a chicken. Oink like a pig. Baa like a sheep.

Just make it believable enough to survive.

Don’t Let the Flies Find You

You can’t hide silently forever.

When the sound-pressure moment begins, make your animal sound before it is too late. If you fail, buzzing flies will appear around you and make your location easier for hunters to spot.

Shoot Only When You’re Sure

Hunters carry a shotgun, but every shot matters.

Shoot the wrong animal and you waste your chance. Shoot the real player and the hunters get closer to victory.

Play With Friends

Play online with 2–8 players in short, chaotic matches full of panic, suspicion, fake confidence, wrong accusations, and terrible animal sounds.
