data.about_the_game:
Write your own legend in the Three Kingdoms! ‘Hero's Ambition: Three Kingdoms’ is a single-player RPG where you take on the role of a hero in the tumultuous late Han and Three Kingdoms era to forge your own path. Play as a loyal general aiding a wise lord to unite the realm, carve out your own domain as a ruler, or roam as a free officer raising private troops to tip the scales of history. Forge sworn brotherhoods, fall in love, marry, and raise heirs. Grow your family, manage properties, or retreat into sacred mountains and great rivers to cultivate martial arts and eloquence alongside your kin. Drill elite legions, experience and rewrite history from diverse perspectives, weave grand diplomatic alliances, or sweep across the land with iron and blood until all under heaven bow before you.

1. Three-Tiered World Structure:

Explore a meticulously crafted three-tier world spanning the strategic world map, bustling city interfaces, and intimate local scenes. From grand territorial conquests and military maneuvers to vibrant urban architecture and detailed life scenes and dramatic events, immerse yourself in an extraordinarily rich and dynamic Three Kingdoms world.

World Map:

 

City:

 

Local Scenes:

 

2. A Grand Stage Across Time:

The game features over 20 starting scenarios, spanning pivotal historical milestones from ‘The Yellow Turban Rebellion’ at the era's beginning to ‘The Battle of Xiling’ at its twilight.

It builds an expansive world featuring over 1,300 historical officers, brought to life with more than 2,000 full-body animated portraits. You can create your own officers before starting the game, while randomly generated officers will also continuously emerge across the Three Kingdoms as gameplay unfolds.

 

3. Rich Gameplay:

Master multiple core combat modes: Legion Battles, Combat, and Debates.

Command in real-time strategy Legion Battles, where victory is achieved by annihilating enemy forces and capturing enemy buildings. Navigate intricate battlefield terrain across more than 100 unique maps divided into five distinct types: Field Battles, Siege Battles, County Battles, Naval Battles, and Pass Battles.

Take the field as supreme commander or fight as an officer in the ranks. Direct vast armies with tactical precision, unleash devastating officer skills, deploy battle formations and siege engines, and exploit the unique tactics and counters of over 30 distinct troop types to crush enemy forces, seize vital buildings, and secure decisive victory.

 

Combat and Debates adopt turn-based card battle mechanics. To enhance your prowess across all three combat modes, cultivate each officer's Command Spirit, Martial Spirit, and Mind Spirit, accumulate Three Spirit Points, and master unique spirits and skills. Freely combine thousands of distinct spirits and skills to build your ultimate officer. With teammates and rivals wielding diverse builds—Assault, Defense, Crit, Counter, Evasion, Damage Reflect, and more—adapt your tactics to counter every foe and remain invincible.

 

 

4. Multi-Role Experience:

Ruler: Command every city under your banner or delegate governance to Governors. Manage domestics to improve each city's economic balance, invest surplus funds into raising armies and recruiting troops, develop technology, or execute specific strategies to expand your power. Once your forces are battle-ready, launch campaigns to conquer enemy cities and unite the realm. Should the burdens of rule weigh heavy, temporarily entrust your faction to a trusted confidant and travel the land to embark on new adventures.

 

Officer: Serve with diligence, excel at quarterly assessments, and accumulate merit and influence to earn appointment as a Governor in command of a city. Rise even further by amassing greater merit to become a Viceroy commanding an entire region. Experience the sweeping historical events of the Three Kingdoms era through the eyes of an officer—watch history unfold as a detached observer, or step forward with crucial advice and turn the tide in pivotal campaign battles to rewrite the destiny of your lord and faction.

 

 

Free Officer: Build your fortune through trade convoys and estate management, construct Private Barracks within cities, raise your own Private Troops, and sign Mercenary Agreements with various factions to fight across the land. Forge mutual trust with powerful warlords amid the flames of war and sign Pacts of Faith to participate in historical events across multiple factions, rising as the shadow overlord of the late Han era.

 

5. Over 2 Million Words of Historical Events:

Experience History Across Diverse Roles and Factions: Continuously expanded throughout Early Access, the game now encompasses nearly every legendary—and obscure—chronicle of the Three Kingdoms era. Spanning nearly a century from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the fall of Eastern Wu, over a hundred scenarios and more than 2 million words of narrative faithfully recreate every classic battle and turning point. In each scenario, experience and reshape history through unique role and faction perspectives. At the Battle of Chibi, play as Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Sun Quan, Zhuge Liang, Zhou Yu, or an officer serving in their ranks. Within Cao Cao's camp, win a Debate to spare Cai Mao and Zhang Yun from execution and recruit them to your banner, or defeat the Sun-Liu coalition in the decisive naval clash to rewrite the course of history.

 

Alter the Course of History: Rely on your tactical brilliance, martial prowess, or silver tongue to overturn historical outcomes. Help Yuan Shao triumph at the Battle of Guandu, lead Liu Bei to a dramatic comeback over Wu at the Battle of Yiling, or assist the Prime Minister in his Northern Expeditions to achieve the grand ambition of restoring the Han Dynasty. Rescue those doomed by fate: lesser figures such as Pan Feng slain yet again by Hua Xiong, Xing Daorong captured and slain by Zhao Yun, Gao Shun going stoically to his death after the Battle of Xiapi, or Tian Feng and Ju Shou swallowed by the tides of Guandu. Save household legends as well: Lu Zhi persecuted by eunuchs, the prodigy Guo Jia who died young, Sun Ce claimed by the curse of Yu Ji, Zhou Yu consumed by frustration, Pang Tong slain at Fallen Phoenix Slope, Xiahou Yuan outwitted and cut down at Mt. Dingjun, Guan Yu meeting his tragic end at Maicheng, Zhang Fei murdered by traitors, Zhang He struck by arrows at Mumen Pass, and Prime Minister Zhuge Liang at Wuzhangyuan—reverse their fatal destinies and redeem history's greatest regrets.

 

Rewrite history as you see fit, even if it leaves certain historical figures with bitter regrets of their own. Save Diaochan from sacrificing herself in the Ensnare plot, stop Cao Pi from forcibly taking Zhen Mi, pit your wits against Zhuge Liang to win Huang Yueying, or take the place of Sun Ce and Zhou Yu to wed the Two Qiaos. Fulfill the unrealized ambitions of Prime Minister Cao and Jiang Wei.

 

A great many of these figures you rescue or ‘spirit away’ will become members of your family, serving as powerful pillars in your conquest of the realm.

 

6. Diverse Social Interactions:

Befriend any officer in the game through conversation, discussing Topics, sharing drinks, giving gifts, cockfighting, sparring, traveling together, mutual tutoring, assisting with tasks, and undertaking unique officer quests. Deepen your ties to become Friends and Best Friends, forging special bonds. Take mentors or disciples to learn and grow together. Become Sworn siblings to achieve greatness side by side. Fall in love, marry, share intimate moments, have children, build a Family, and nurture talented heirs. Even married women can be won over through special means, capturing their hearts to welcome them into your inner court.

 

 

7. Other Features:

1. City Commissions: Undertake engaging commissions across every City to reap formidable rewards. The ‘Resurrection’ commission can bring a fallen Officer back to life. The ‘Five Sacred Mountains Pilgrimage’ substantially enhances your abilities. The ‘Martial Arts Marriage Contest’ allows you to win an exceptional bride. The ‘Like Father, Like Daughter’ commission even lets you entice your Good friend's daughter to serve your cause, and much more.

 

2. The Grand Tournament: Test your mettle in the Grand Tournament held annually in the capital. Compete in martial duels, battles of wits in Debate, or trials of tactical command as elite contenders from across the land vie for lavish rewards.

 

3. A Living, Dynamic World: Immerse yourself in a living world where NPC Officers act on their own ambitions—resigning or even choosing to Rebel when dissatisfied with their liege. Free Officers will organize Private Troops to entrench themselves in counties, seizing vulnerable or abandoned Cities to declare themselves Ruler. Officers form bonds, forge vendettas, and have a chance each year to welcome newborn children.

 

4，Party System: Every hero needs allies. Form a party of up to five members to accompany you across the realm. Invite officers to join your party, tour scenic vistas with your spouses, hire mercenaries for protection, or hire Wagon teams to run trade routes and amass wealth. Your companions stand with you during story events and fight by your side in Combat—for reshaping history is never a solitary quest.

 

5. Dynamic World Map Events: Discover unexpected encounters across the World Map. As you journey across the realm, you may clash with robbers, bandits, barbarian warbands, and ferocious beasts—or cross paths with traveling Peddlers, master blacksmiths, and even an elusive Immortal.

 

6. Family System: Beyond your own Family, powerful aristocratic clans pursue their own interests. They compete with you to purchase property, vie for dominance over the Market, form temporary pacts of mutual aid, or conspire against you in the shadows.

 

7. Trade & Commerce: Recruit a Wagon caravan into your ranks and trade goods across different Cities to turn a swift profit. Establish your own Trading House, dispatch Family members to manage it, and enjoy an automated stream of wealth.

 

8. Private Troops: Command Family Officers to manage your Private Troops, oversee Property purchased in cities, or research Family Technology, which directly bolsters the combat prowess of your Private Troops.

  

9. Vertical and Horizontal Alliances: Factions will periodically form a Vertical Alliance to besiege the strongest faction, while the targeted faction forms a Horizontal Alliance to counter the threat. As a Ruler, freely choose which alliance to join and savor the thrilling intrigue of high-stakes grand strategy.

 

10. Building Events: Officers will no longer simply wait for you to call upon them—Wine-loving officers invite you to share drinks, playful ones challenge you to Cockfighting, and those with Wanderlust ask you to travel together. Long-unseen Lovers, Beloveds, and spouses will visit your door, while unfamiliar Officers may seek you out in admiration. If skilled in Medicine, visit the Clinic to assist in treating ailing Officers. Yet peril also brews: when Order is poor, theft at your Residence, assassin ambushes, or rival Officers plotting to Assassinate can all strike. Capture the culprits to cast them into prison. The world is unpredictable, and unexpected twists await at every turn.

 

11. Festival Events: As seasons turn, specific festivals will trigger unique events. Celebrate New Year's Eve banquets, Spring Festival gatherings, Shangsi springtime excursions, and Dragon Boat Festival dumpling feasts; during the Qixi and Double Ninth Festivals, enjoy an increased Success Rate for their corresponding interactions.

 

12. Disaster System: Every City has a Chance to suffer six types of disasters—Earthquake, Flood, Drought, Locust Swarm, Plague, and Snowstorm—inflicting varying degrees of destruction and loss upon Commerce, Agriculture, Population, and Buildings.

 

13. Scenic Area and Pet Systems: Journey across the realm's iconic mountains and rivers with companions to undertake Training. Tame fearsome beasts like bears and tigers, and deploy them to fight alongside you in Combat.

 

14. Create Officer and Historical Officer Editing Systems

Create completely custom Officers or introduce a New Faction at the start of your journey. You can also import custom portraits by placing your artwork in the Portraits folder. Every historical figure can be reconfigured in the Historical Officer Editor—adjusting their portraits, 3D models, poses, and full array of attributes.

 

15. Beyond these features, the game offers a rich array of systems including forging, weaving, identification, and much more. Step into the realm and discover them all for yourself.

 

————————————————————————————————

A Final Word: We are a small independent team from China with fewer than ten members, and, above all, die-hard fans who grew up playing the Taikou Risshiden and Romance of the Three Kingdoms series. Unfortunately, a proper sequel to Taikou Risshiden never came. Rather than waiting passively, we thought: why not take matters into our own hands to fulfill this long-held dream? That was the starting point of everything.

Starting completely from scratch, it took us five and a half years of dedicated development before we finally launched the Simplified Chinese Early Access (EA) version in March 2025. Over the past year and a half, guided by invaluable feedback from a vast number of Chinese players, we have continuously updated and refined the game. Today, we are thrilled to officially release Version 1.0, complete with English, Japanese, and Korean localization.

Of course, the game is far from perfect. Due to its high degree of freedom, complex systems, and intricate character-specific storylines, there may still be rough edges. We sincerely hope you will share your feedback with us so we can keep improving. As for the art and visual elements, while they have undergone multiple overhauls, there are still areas that need polish. Rest assured, we will continue to refine them.

The official 1.0 release is a major milestone, but it is by no means the end of our journey. We will continue to push updates and commit our full passion toward creating an exceptional historical sandbox RPG.

Journey back in time to where it all began!

Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis brings a new chapter to the beloved tower defense saga, packed with the charm fans fell in love with. Jump into a portal in time to rewrite history and stop young Vez'nan before darkness takes hold!

Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands, at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields and build strategic defenses to outsmart enemy waves.

18 Handcrafted Campaign Stages

Travel across three landscapes of early Linirea: the Citadel, the Stormcloud Depths and the far lands of Arcania.

Each stage is handcrafted piece by piece, from its unique mechanics and paths to the hidden Easter eggs waiting in every corner, so no two battles ever feel the same. Standing between you and Linirea's future are 40+ enemies from 5 factions and 6 colossal bosses.

5 Ways to Conquer Every Stage

Beyond the main campaign, every stage unlocks 5 game modes that change the rules entirely.

Our favorite? Classic Rush. Go back in time to 2011 and take on each stage with the original Kingdom Rush arsenal. Switch things up: survive one devastating wave in Iron Challenge, outpace enemies in Blitz, lead four heroes with no spells in Hero Party, or trust only your towers and spells in Spell Rush.

Lead Legends Old and New

Reunite with beloved characters and meet new allies. Choose your dream team from 12 heroes, 15 towers and 9 spells, mixing classic favorites with brand-new faces to find the synergies that suit your strategy. Then customize your army like never before, with individual upgrade trees for every hero and spell, plus global tower upgrades you can retune between stages.

15 Years Holding the Line

Fifteen years after the first creep marched down the road, Kingdom Rush returns to the lands where it all began, with bold new twists, epic fights and the signature Kingdom Rush humor. Along the way, you'll encounter surprising returns, memorable challenges and our most ambitious adventure yet. 

Made with love in Montevideo, Uruguay, down to the last detail. Our team keeps making new campaigns, stages, heroes, spells and towers coming this year and beyond.

Defend the past to change the future!

Game Features:

  • 27 upgradeable characters:

Become an alchemist in Diamond City, where growing a business means growing your own workers. Farm, craft, and sell your creations as you build relationships and navigate a dark fantasy story with multiple endings.

  • Build Your Alchemy Business: Grow magical crops, craft valuable goods, and put your homegrown workforce to work.

  • Meet the City's Unusual Residents: Discover over 40 NPCs and relationship paths for six central heroines.

  • Shape the City's Fate: Earn the trust of six factions and explore branching stories shaped by your choices and reputation.

Grow ingredients, turn them into valuable creations, and sell them to fund your next expansion. Along the way, fulfill orders, build relationships, and uncover the city's stranger side.

Cultivate the Extraordinary

Grow over 100 crops and experiment with traits to improve your harvests. Expand underground and use alchemical circles to build a flourishing, self-sustaining farm.

Turn Curiosities into Profit

Decorate your shop and stock its shelves with crops, potions, and rare curiosities. Build your reputation to attract non-human customers and unlock lucrative special orders.

Grow Your Own Workforce

Meet the Peoplesprouts: workers you grow yourself. Assign them to farming, retail, and manufacturing to automate your business.

Match their talents to the job—and give them time to recover. Overwork takes a toll on their Sanity.

Turn Experiments into Opportunity

Transform materials into valuable goods or grant your Peoplesprouts powerful abilities. Experiment with volatile elements and combine alchemy with Oracles to discover extraordinary results.

Borrow the Power of Ancient Gods

Collect and combine divine blessings for powerful bonuses during each time rewind. Just beware of the gods behind them—and the influence of their whispers.

Decide Who to Trust

Win the favor of six rival factions to unlock special orders and new story possibilities. Your reputation and choices help determine how Diamond City's story ends.

Oracle Summons

Try your luck summoning blessings from Ancient and Outer Gods. Their gifts could be just what your next experiment needs.

The Golden Cage Card Parlor

Challenge the city's residents to Blackjack. When luck fails, remember your two favorite gods: Save and Load.

Fishing

Cast your line across Diamond City and reel in fish, strange surprises—even an Ancient God.

Sissi

A barmaid blessed with superhuman strength—and your very first full-time hire. She originally dreamed of becoming a housemaid, only to discover a surprising natural talent for farming.

Nene

The daughter of a mathematician, Nene has a brilliant mind, razor-sharp intuition, and the combat skills to back them up. But her true talent shines through in the end: after becoming a Peoplesprout keeper, Nene finally found the perfect place to put her skills to use.

Gretel

Feel like adventuring alone is far too safe? Then bring this amazing trouble magnet along! She'll bring a never-ending stream of danger your way.

With shimmering rose-gold fur, a fluffy tail, and incredible marksmanship, Gretel seems to encounter mysterious incidents wherever she goes, recording each one in her Field Notes.

Jimo Li

Meow? Meow, meow!

Aurora Ludwig

Princess, goddess, sacrifice... Aurora bears many identities and possesses extraordinary magical power that greatly influences Diamond City itself.

A woman shrouded in mystery, her true nature remains impossible to discern.

？？？？？

[FILE CLASSIFIED] ///// EXTREME DANGER /////

Bone Nail Studio is a team of passionate game developers (and cat lovers) dedicated to creating fun and engaging games. We strive for quality in everything we do, though we occasionally go a little off the rails. This is our fourth game and the official sequel to Yog-Sothoth's Yard. Anyway, we hope you enjoy exploring the world we've created!

Thank you all for your continued support!

—Bone Nail Studio

data.about_the_game:
Tokyo has fallen. In the wake of the 'Collapse,' time is your ultimate weapon. Unleash real-time skills, predict enemy moves, and deliver devastating counters in this high-stakes Tactical Timeline RPG.

《Story》

Tokyo has collapsed. In a city where reality itself is eroding, grotesque entities known as 《Anomalies》 roam the ruined streets.

While working as a simple delivery boy, Soma Hoshigami is brutally attacked by an Aberration—leaving him in a fractured, 'Half-turned' state where man and monster fuse into one. He is rescued and taken into custody not as a citizen, but as 'lost property' by Rena Hizuki, a lethal investigator from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Public Safety Department, Foreign Affairs Fifth Division (commonly known as the Public Safety Mutation Response Division).

Step into the shoes of Rena and Soma in a world choking on reality-shattering contamination.

Track down 'Tiny True,' the demonic narcotic flooding the streets. Uncover the truth behind 'Stigmas,' the cursed body-carved glyphs infecting the youth. Expose the mysterious cult pulling the strings from the shadows. Engage in fast-paced, hyper-stylish combat to slice through terrifying foes and unravel the mystery of a world tearing at the seams.

《Battle System》

Unleash total dominance with a refreshing, high-octane combat system. Master the flow of time itself as you stack and chain devastating skills to obliterate your enemies with massive, satisfying combos.

◆ Innovative Timeline System

Predict. React. Intercept. The Tactical Counter-Timeline combat interface features a dynamic, timeline-driven gauge that exposes the exact timing and nature of incoming enemy attacks.

Use this timeline to program your own skills, shatter enemy offensives, and take complete control of the battlefield.

Slow down time or pause the action at any moment to analyze tactical forecasts, track cooldowns, and execute precise strategies.

Whether you are delivering a punishing counter-attack or slipping buffs into the narrow gaps of an enemy’s onslaught, victory is determined by your strategic intellect.

◆ Master the Speed of Combat

While the timeline offers deep, strategic contemplation, the combat scales with your skill. As you master the mechanics, the gameplay transforms into an aggressive, adrenaline-fueled experience that rivals pure action games!

Will you play with relentless aggression, or stay cool and intellectual to dissect formidable bosses?

Choose your combat style, slash through bizarre threats with unparalleled flair, and conquer the ultimate anomalies.

《Immersive Voice Acting》

Experience a fully voiced, gripping narrative that drags you straight into the heart of the crisis.

《Cutting-Edge Visuals》

Immerse yourself in a vibrant, cel-shaded art style paired with custom, unsettling shaders designed exclusively to bring the horrific nature of the Anomalies to life in spectacular, bone-chilling detail.

《Searing Soundtracks & Themes》

Ignite your battle spirit with a pulse-pounding opening theme and an electrifying lineup of in-game insert songs that will elevate your gaming experience to new heights.

≪Early Purchase Bonus≫
・Bonus Skins for Rena and Soma
・Extra Battle: Voidfall
*The Extra Battle "Voidfall" is scheduled to be sold separately at a later date.

data.about_the_game:
After years in confinement at the hands of the Federal Bureau of Control (FBC), Dylan Faden emerges into a warped Manhattan at the peak of a paranatural crisis.

Charged with combating a mysterious cosmic entity as it alters fundamental aspects of our reality, Dylan must harness his new-found powers to take the fight to the myriad threats overwhelming Manhattan.

Join Dylan in this sequel to the multi-award-winning CONTROL to explore the expansive zones of a city overrun by the corrupting influences of the chaotic Hiss, invasive micro-organism, the Mold, and other twisted paranatural threats.

On the path to unlocking the full potential of his paranatural abilities Dylan will also seek out his sister, FBC Director Jesse Faden, as he bids to comprehend and contain the dangers that have spilled beyond the confines of the Oldest House to tear our world apart.

STEP INTO A WARPED REALITY   

Explore multiple areas of a ravaged Manhattan in an expansive, unfamiliar, and exciting world. 

Traverse perception-bending locations and grapple with gravity anomalies that distort the vertical and horizontal plane, adding additional dimensions to puzzles and new tactical decisions to combat. 

Meet faces old and new on a path fraught with risk but rich in opportunity as the cityscape is reshaped and reality is redefined by a godlike force.

MASTER THE PARANATURAL 

Channel the raw experiences of Dylan’s past to help understand his present and dig deeper into the inner workings of the FBC and reveal the horrors threatening humankind.

Tap into power he must learn to master and take choices to shape how his abilities manifest and grow.

Explore a deep progression system to define how Dylan adapts to emerging dangers. Forge connections crucial to Dylan’s fight to retain his humanity as he journeys from former test subject to paranatural superweapon.

THE FIGHT SHIFTS. YOUR WEAPON SHIFTS WITH IT. 

Meet constantly evolving threats head-on, utilising the environment, deploying elemental abilities and using the raw force of Dylan’s shapeshifting melee weapon, the Aberrant.

Wield the Aberrant in its many deadly forms. Deliver bone-crunching blows with a two-handed hammer and flow seamlessly into the swift precision of dual-wielded blades as this paranatural weapon morphs on demand to meet each new challenge.

SHARED LEGACY. NEW THREAT 

FBC Director Jesse Faden's lockdown is no longer holding. A paranatural catastrophe has spilled beyond the Oldest House and onto the streets of Manhattan, and the Bureau's grip on containment is failing.

Jesse Faden walked into the Oldest House to confront the threat within. Now Dylan must walk out of it to contain the threat beyond.

data.about_the_game:
In Spellcaster University, you take on the role of the director of a magic university in a colourful world of heroic fantasy. Build your school, manage your budget, recruit teachers. Will you turn it into a black magic academy, with the best professors of necromancy and demonology? Or a place in harmony with nature to train druids and shamans? Or why not train adventurous mages, offering them options to learn how to fight and be stealthy? But this will require surviving the ruthless attacks of the orc tribes and the controls of the education authorities.

  • Build your university using an original magic decks mechanism. Each game will be unique.
  • Access different decks according to the magic taught in your schools. Make choices and take advantage of opportunities to create a unique university.
  • Explore the Arcane Deck to access artifacts with strange powers and rooms that defy reality.
  • Dive into the Deck of Light to take care of your students and teachers.
  • Use the Nature Deck to gain access to a wide range of magical beasts.
  • Choose the Alchemy Deck to boost the production of mana and potions.
  • Yield to the Shadow Deck to teach real discipline to all those nasty students.


  • Manage the well-being of your students by building refectories, dormitories, rest rooms... and ensure their discipline with a dungeon.
  • Select your students: traits, personality, alignment, wealth... each aspect is important.
  • Push your students towards a glorious future. At the end of their studies, discover their future (necromancer, archimage, peasant...) according to the success of their studies, and win new bonuses.


  • Upgrade your rooms with powerful artifacts like the World Tree Wood Table Set or the Soul Eater Bed.
  • Fill your school with legendary creatures: dragons, fauns, pegasus, janitors...
  • Choose the rules of your school: exemplary punishments, recruitment conditions, organic meals, paying dormitories...


  • Choose, through multiple-choice events, how to interact with the different factions of the world.
  • Negotiate with the Adventurers Guild. Ask the king for help. Discuss shamanism with the orcs.
  • Threaten the Dark Lord. Pretend to listen to the grievances of the staff representative. Lie to the witch hunters.
  • Every choice can have short or long term consequences. Be careful before saying “No” to the student delegate!


  • Flee from the armies of darkness by building your university in isolated environments: lake, mountain, desert, volcano, giant turtle back, etc.
  • Collect powerful grimoires to strengthen your university and face increasingly hostile environments.
  • Find new allies to help you in your fight.
  • Take advantage of your trained students' bonuses accumulated throughout the campaign.

data.about_the_game:
Slow Roads is a casual driving game designed to capture the zen of a long drive on a scenic road. Zone out as you coast along lifelike roads that wind endlessly through procedurally-generated landscapes, with configurable locations, road styles, seasons, weather, and vehicles. Generate a unique world, throw on some music, and just drive.

Endless driving zen

Simply chase the horizon through endless, ever-unique landscapes, with no objectives, challenges, or distractions. Disconnect from stress while you roll through valleys, fields, forests, and coastlines at your own pace.

Infinitely-generated scenic roads

A novel procedural engine generates the landscapes and roads organically, meaning every stretch of road is unique and non-repeating. Choose your preferred style, from casual to winding corners, wide or narrow, and paved or off-road. World generation is seeded, allowing you to revisit any especially nice road you find.

Settings for location, season, weather, and time-of-day

Select a location and instantly switch between scene styles to suit your mood, with options for sun, cloud, snow, and time-of-day. Locations are based on real places - roll through the hills of the Peak District, coast along the California shore, or rove Off-World if you really need an escape.

Choose the vehicle that suits your style

"Driving zen" means different things to different people, whether that's cruising in the coupe, rallying in the hatch, or kissing each apex with the sports car. Maybe take the coach for a slow tour, or try hitting the perfect lean into every corner with the bike.

Vehicle customisation and tuning

Optionally customise your vehicle's style and tuning, with controls over colours, wheels, plates, engines, handling, and more. Any vehicle's engine can be electric or combustion, with the latter having options for manual or automatic transmission.

Casual or sim-style driving

Configure the gameplay to your own comforts with controls for steer assist, camera pose, traffic, and more. You can even let the car drive for you, with options for automatic steering, automatic speed control, or full autodrive. The cockpit view can be configured for sim-style driving, with support for controllers and wheels*

*Please note that force feedback is not currently supported by the engine, but is planned for a near-term content update. Check out the demo to verify your device's compatibility.

Just drive...

Slow Roads is designed for minimalist gameplay, with a lightweight engine that is hyper-optimised for endless, real-time environment generation - less so for crash physics or stunts. Take it slow, stay on the road, and let the simplicity of a mindless drive scratch an itch you didn't know you had. Having said that, nobody will stop you if you prefer to cruise at 300kph or rally on the mountain trails...

Steam-exclusive features

If you've played the web version, you may wonder what's going to be different on Steam. In the full game you'll find dozens of exclusive upgrades and features, including:

  • Extra locations, starting with the new California coast

  • New road styles, including off-road trails

  • New vehicles, starting with the Hatch and Sports car

  • Vehicle customisation, both for style and physics tuning

  • Options for combustion engines and manual transmissions for all vehicles

  • Configurable traffic modes - set density, speed, and which lane(s) they drive in

  • A music interface for playing from local files or public radio stations

  • Improved scenery detail and high-definition assets

  • Improved controller support

  • Profiles for saving your progress and settings

  • Expanded settings for gameplay and graphics

  • Milestone achievements

Lastly, buying on Steam enables the web version to remain free and ad-free for everybody, while supporting ongoing development. Since initial release in 2022, the web version has never featured ads, microtransactions, or paywalls. It will remain this way and will continue to receive small updates into the future, though will represent a more minimal experience of the game.

Try the demo!

The demo gives a short (distance-limited) sample of the main features in the game, and is the best way to test gameplay and compatibility. Some features are locked or limited in the demo, but all are instantly available in the full game.

Post-launch roadmap

Slow Roads is a living project, with active development of extra locations, features, and vehicles continuing beyond initial release. The list is long, but the main goals for upcoming updates include:

  • Force feedback support for wheel controllers

  • Rain, dynamic weather effects, and a day/night cycle

  • New locations set elsewhere in the world (see WIP of an Alps location above)

  • Enhanced environmental details like structures and wildlife

  • A world editor allowing you to alter parameters and generate custom locations

These are intended to be free updates to the core game, added after the initial version 1 release. There are currently no plans to gate future features behind DLCs, though as the core game grows the base price may rise in alignment.

Human-made over 5 years

No AI has been used to generate any code or content in or about the game, and never will be. Slow Roads has been a labour of love since the project began in 2021, and has been built with a decade of experience in 3D graphics and creative software development. Textures are hand-drawn, sounds are recorded locally, and all systems are designed and engineered specifically for the unique context of the game. This is a solo-developed project that I take great care over, and I believe AI simply doesn't belong in creative projects like these.

Please note that procedural generation is not a form of generative AI; the procedures used to generate the world in the game are mathematical functions that have been derived and defined by hand, with direct creative intent.

Guess Who's Ack, Ack Again...

Mars Attracts is a theme park management game set on Mars. Play as the devious Martians from the cult-classic universe of Mars Attacks™ and build your amusement park empire, abducting humans from across history to display in customizable enclosures for the entertainment of curious Martian guests. Study humanity in their natural habitat, or subject them to whatever twisted experiments you can imagine!

Business Is Boomin'!

Take on the role of a Martian CEO and confront the challenge of theme park management — craft the perfect red planet tourist attraction, complete with human enclosures, death-defying rides, and a carefully selected range of amenities. You won’t last long if you can’t turn a profit.

  • Cater to your guests’ diverse needs by unlocking a range of merch stalls, food vendors, and colorfully gruesome decorations.  

  • Manage supply chains by assigning helpful porters to keep your park running smoothly. 

  • Balance your books by taking out loans and customising prices with an in-depth financial management system. 

  • Gain the approval of the colourful cast of Martian board members by completing optional missions and park inspections.

Improvise, Abduct, Overcome

Humans come in all shapes, sizes, and bounciness. Employ advanced Martian technology to procure humans from across history – from Ancient Rome to the Wild West – and build the perfect habitat to ensure they have no idea they ever left.

  • Launch abduction missions to Earth to capture humans from across history, each with their own set of unique traits and preferences.

  • Gather knowledge of humans from different time periods to learn how to construct the perfect enclosure.

  • Collect unique historical humans including Julius Caesar, Cleopatra, and Date Masamune. 

  • Tailor enclosures to appeal to each human’s unique preferences using decor items collected from expeditions. 

  • Unhappy humans won’t remain docile for long. Hire security teams and build defences to deal with rampaging humans before they trash your beautiful park and kill your innocent guests.

It's Probing Time!

For centuries, Martian explorers have scoured the galaxy for signs of intelligent life. So far, no luck. Nevertheless, there is much to be learned by studying human behavior. Maximize their happiness to enlighten your guests on the mysteries of these strange enclosed-brained creatures, or push your captives to the limit and see what breaks. For science, of course.

  • Unlock new buildings and staff abilities from the research tree by performing gruesome experiments on captive humans.

  • Dissect excess humans to construct anatomical horrors to decorate your park. 

  • Satisfy your guests’ need for random acts of cruelty by building torture devices, running experiments, or selling merch made from human body parts.

data.about_the_game:
The Magus Circle is a vampire-survivors, rogue-lite game where you draw to cast spells!

When fate comes knocking, will you open the door?

Once you’ve already ruined just about everything, is there really much harm in trying again? Magic itself is under siege and you have found yourself caught in the midst of a cosmic war you did not sign up for. With nothing but your wits and your best scribing hand, you have been charged with protecting humanity's greatest ally: The Magus Circle.

Key Features

  • Hand Drawn Spellcasting: Actively draw your arcane sigils to cast your spells. You don't need to be an artist. Even the most crudely drawn sigils still hold magic within.

  • Diverse Build Paths: Draw magic sigils, casting 20 unique spells augmented by 600 possible upgrades.

  • Maps & Content: Battle hordes of foes across 4 unique planets to face off against colossal bosses. Play as the 6 mages of the circle, each with their own skill trees, abilities and emotional baggage.

  • Progression: Unlock familiars, wager your winnings, concoct potions, grow a garden and more!

  • Story: Explore the manor, get to know your fellow mages and uncover the secrets of The Circle.

  • Controls: The Magus Circle supports drawing tablets, touch screens, and controllers. If your drawing tablet uses Microsoft Ink, disable the setting for your drawings to work. We recommend using a mouse, drawing tablet or touch screen for the best play experience. The Magus Circle features accessibility settings to slow or freeze time when drawing or a button press mode. We recommend using one of these features for controller play.

data.about_the_game:
Raise the Divine Dragon You’ve Nurtured to Overcome the Catastrophe!

"DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. With the game’s ending achievable in as little as about one hour, you can enjoy multiple playthroughs and experiment with various training strategies.

Raising the Dragon Girl

To prevent the impending World's Doom in one year, you must raise a dragon girl known as the "Divine Dragon." This food-loving dragon eats anything and transforms it into her own power. Meat, fish, rocks, iron... no, even lava, mountains, and other people's houses become fine delicacies in her eyes.

Battle Against the Catastrophe

A mysterious enemy stands in your way, intent on bringing about the end of the world. Will you fight with powerful attacks? Use defense and healing skills? Or weaken them gradually with poison? Combine over 200 different skills to create synergies and build your own unique strategy.

Your Unique Growth Through Nurturing

The Divine Dragon is a pure being, just born. It’s not only her strength you must nurture, but her heart as well. Depending on how you raise her, her appearance and personality will change over time. The people she interacts with and the way she spends her year will determine the various possible endings to the story. Ultimately, the truth behind the "calamity" may also be revealed.

However, the Divine Dragon eats "anything".
If you raise her the wrong way...

Beyond Raising Your Dragon — 25 Possible Futures

As you experience “A Year with the Divine Dragon” again and again and progress through the story, the Divine Dragon’s future will eventually branch into 25 different endings.

What kind of life awaits the Divine Dragon you spent an entire year raising?

Her future depends on how you raise her.

About the Author: Kanawo

An indie game creator who develops games solo.

Continues to release popular titles, including "Noel the Mortal Fate," which was ported to Nintendo Switch™ / PlayStation®4 / Xbox in 2022 (available on Steam® since May 2018).

DRAPLINE Streaming Guidelines

  • Streaming is OK!
    Feel free to stream on YouTube, Twitch, NicoNico, X, or any other platform.
    We’d really appreciate it if you could include a link to this page in your video description.

  • Monetization
    Using platform monetization features (e.g., YouTube Partner Program, Super Chat, etc.) is totally fine!

  • Notes
    Please refrain from doing anything illegal or anything that would bother others.

data.about_the_game:
Build, cook, and run your restaurant with your own two hands!

In Tasty Chef, you are both the restaurant owner and a hands-on member of the team. Design work areas, purchase ingredients, manage storage, prepare dishes step by step, and serve customers before the orders pile up!

Every part of the restaurant is up to you. Expand your space, freely place cooking equipment, storage units, and workstations, improve your kitchen flow, and build a restaurant that runs efficiently.

Design Your Own Menu

Unlock new recipes, choose which dishes to serve each day, disable recipes you do not want to make, and customize flavors to create a menu that matches your restaurant’s style.

Each item has its own unique preparation process. Prepare ingredients, use different equipment, complete every cooking step, and finally serve the finished food or drink to waiting customers.

Build a Reliable Staff Team

Running a restaurant does not mean doing everything yourself. You can hire NPC employees to help with all kinds of tasks the player can perform, including taking orders, preparing ingredients, cooking, serving, restocking, and organizing supplies.

Build a team that can keep the restaurant running on its own, so you can focus on growing the business. When the rush hour hits, you can always jump back into the kitchen and help out yourself.

Experience Different Types of Restaurants

The launch version includes the bubble tea shop and sushi restaurant. Start with a cozy bubble tea shop and unlock the sushi restaurant as you progress. Each restaurant features its own recipes, equipment, preparation processes, and management mechanics.

Planned update: The bakery is not available in the launch version and is planned for an update in October 2026.

The bubble tea shop focuses on drink preparation and flavor customization, while the sushi restaurant introduces completely different systems such as conveyor belt sushi. You will need to redesign your space and build a workflow that fits each restaurant’s unique style.

There are no traditional fixed levels. Each restaurant is a business you can continue to expand, optimize, and personalize.

Run the Restaurant Alone or With Friends

Manage the entire restaurant by yourself, rely on NPC employees for support, or play together with friends. Divide tasks, cooperate efficiently, and keep every area of the restaurant running smoothly.

Whether you enjoy hands-on cooking, planning efficient workflows, managing inventory, or training a reliable staff team, Tasty Chef lets you build your ideal restaurant in your own way.

  • Hands-on cooking gameplay with unique preparation steps

  • Freely expandable and customizable restaurants

  • Ingredient purchasing, storage, and restocking management

  • Adjustable menus, recipes, and flavors

  • NPC employees who can take orders, cook, serve, and restock

  • Multiple restaurant types with different mechanics and workflows

  • Single-player and multiplayer support

  • A relaxing, cozy atmosphere with bright colors and a 2.5D-style view in fully 3D environments

data.about_the_game:
From Nightdive Studios, SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits.

Enter a near-future dystopian world as security consultant Colonel John R. Blade as you take on the seductively evil Doctor Elexis Sinclaire. When Elexis, the CEO of SinTEK Industries, begins injecting the streets with a DNA-altering drug, it's time to reassess the laws of morality. As Blade, you've made a religion out of fighting crime. Now you're going to make Elexis pay for her sins by taking on her unholy army of genetically-engineered mutants.

SiN was celebrated for introducing a groundbreaking amount of interactivity in every level. Hack your way into computer terminals using DOS-style code, use elevators and security cameras to wreak havoc, you can even zip around in a forklift, patrol boat and a helicopter. Your actions have consequences, creating branching paths as the game progresses. SiN also helped to pioneer the ability to knock weapons out of an opponent's hands and take area-specific damage from their attacks.

SiN: Reloaded includes the Wages of SiN extra mission pack, where you take on a diabolical mafia boss with a new army of dangerous mutants. Both games have been optimized using the KEX Engine to play on modern systems. The graphics throughout have been beautifully remastered with new textures, control schemes have been modernized, and maps have been improved with Nightdive’s established precision.

Features

  • Play the original SiN and the SiN: Wages of Sin extra mission pack, optimized using the KEX Engine.

  • Beautifully remastered graphics with HD textures and models, (up to) 4K resolution at 144 FPS, anti-aliasing, and upgraded 2D screens and menu art.

  • Overhauled control schemes and modernized UI.

  • Improved maps throughout the game.

  • Swap between remastered visuals and the original SiN Gold version.

  • Brand-new achievements.

  • Higher resolution Zak Belika tracks mixed/engineered by Chris Mock.

data.about_the_game:
Join a heartfelt adventure where friendship, care, and hard work restore harmony to a forgotten world. Rebuild the lost bond between humans and dragons as you transform abandoned lands into a place filled with warmth and joy. Grow crops, gather resources, raise adorable dragons, and help townsfolk rediscover their happiness.

Befriend cheerful dragons, each with unique traits and special powers that assist you on the farm and beyond. Care for them with love and playtime, and they’ll become loyal companions who sense people’s needs and lend their magic wherever it’s needed.

Rebuild your grandpa’s abandoned farm into a thriving sanctuary. Grow crops, harvest resources, and craft valuable goods while your dragon helpers support every step. Watch the land come back to life as your care turns a forgotten place into a haven of joy.

Cooking is the heart of crafting in Dragon Shelter. Meals strengthen bonds with neighbors, lift spirits, and unlock new opportunities. Every harvest can be used in cooking, crafting, alchemy, or trade – making each recipe meaningful and rewarding.

A nearby town has fallen into gloom, but hope remains. With the help of your dragons, reconnect with the townsfolk, uncover their stories, and rekindle their sense of joy and community.

Venture into a vibrant fantasy world filled with magical biomes, curious creatures, and hidden secrets. Every journey offers delightful surprises and the chance to restore life to forgotten lands.

Celebrate 35 years of top-down sci-fi horror-action with the definitive Alien Breed Collection. Experience the complete library of games, extras and more from the franchise’s first era, all optimised in their original formats and including modern controls.

The Vault Interactive Archives

Step behind the airlocks to explore an expansive archive of the series' history through an in-universe interactive experience, hiding more than a few secrets. The Vault offers a deep dive into the concept art and original retail launches, while The Timeline features exclusive developer interviews and retrospective videos from the original team.

Updated Combat, UI & Customisation

An upgraded hardware interface makes the original titles more accessible without losing the soul of the original gameplay. Precision controls as standard, with full twin-stick support for both 2D and 3D titles, and classic Mouse and Keyboard support for 3D. Drastically improved framerates provide a fluid FPS experience. Tactical Save States provide multiple slots to pause and continue different runs. Fine-tune your visuals, audio and gameplay settings across the entire collection with the Global Customisation options.

Retro-Visual Suite 

Switch between a classic 4:3 aspect ratio or modern 16:9 formats. Capture the authentic 90s glow with the CRT Experience offering professional-grade Scanlines, CRT TV, and "Mega CRT" filters. Toggle custom in-game screen bezels to perfectly frame the retro action on modern monitors.

A build-driven action roguelite inspired by the forbidden path of cultivation.

Play as a "Bait Soul" struggling to break a tragic destiny, using every resource to carve a path of survival through a dungeon fraught with danger.

An innovative "Soul Orb + Support Item" loadout system.

Each weapon slot (Soul Orb) has unique attributes, and Support Items grant chain buffs to adjacent weapons.

Will you pursue extreme damage output or build an impenetrable defense? Flexibly adjust the layout of Weapons, Soul Orbs, and Support Items to crush powerful enemies with strategy.

Reject tedious controls and focus purely on movement and strategy.

Your character automatically attacks locked enemies. You only need to focus on Blinking to dodge lethal attacks and Sprinting to reposition. With an extremely low learning curve and fluid action experience, you can control the battlefield with just one hand.

Hundreds of functionally diverse Relics are scattered deep within the dungeon.

They are not just stat sticks; they can fundamentally change your combat mechanics. Every pickup can lead to a qualitative leap, making every adventure a unique loot-hunting experience.

Combat is not everything.

In this ever-changing underground palace, various mysterious events and secret rooms are hidden. Mysterious merchants, ancient altars, unknown gambles... Every corner hides opportunity or crisis, waiting for you to discover.

data.about_the_game:
In this martial arts-themed management simulation game, assume the role of a sect leader. As a member of a declining sect, you must flee with your disciples and survive in a desolate world, striving to rejuvenate your sect.

Navigate challenges posed by food shortages and harsh weather, hunt dangerous beasts, lift the spirits of your disciples, and manually construct all necessary facilities brick by brick. Recruit talents from the wilderness or cities to become your disciples, train their martial skills, and gradually restore your sect's strength, rebuilding your unique sect headquarters.

Forge alliances or sow discord among other sects, stirring up turbulent conflicts in this martial-dominated world. Seize power, defeat century-old formidable sects, conquer the JiangHu, and become the new legend.

Detailed Interactive World

Explore vast forests, snowy plains, and deserts where every plant and tree can be collected and processed into resources for crafting and constructing everything necessary for survival. Your ultimate goal is to revive your sect.

Travel through the Central Plains, explore other sects and ancient ruins, and seek clues to legendary martial arts manuals and mythical weapons.

Train exceptional disciples and command them to defend, attack, and compete against other sects. They can bring back rare treasures for you. Or you can appoint them to manage your sect, or even swiftly seize other sects' headquarters and participate in establishing new branch sects.

Flesh and Reality

In the desolate yet vibrant primal landscapes, disciples will be challenged by needs such as hunger, sleep, and entertainment. They must also withstand the ever-changing weather and natural disasters, maintaining morale against the elements to avoid breakdowns.

Disciples not yet trained in martial arts must tread carefully, as even a single beast can leave lifelong scars on their bodies.

However, the body is the foundation of martial arts. As disciples master internal skills and techniques, their health and physical strength enhance their martial capabilities. Some extreme individuals even replace arms or organs with parts of mythical beasts to seek greater power.

Martial Arts and Combining Techniques

The ultimate pursuit of martial arts mastery is the greatest desire for those in the martial world. Each disciple begins their journey by reinforcing their foundation and enduring the arduous process of opening their dantian, before training in coveted internal skills and techniques.

However, mastering martial arts is just the first step; diligent practice forms only the foundation of progress. Advancing on the martial path requires providing disciples with rooms that complement their skills, along with the right elixirs and supportive items for rapid advancement.

Combat is also a crucial aspect of enhancing strength. To truly stand unrivaled in the martial world, one must seek out powerful internal skills for disciples, pair them with appropriate techniques, and equip them with mythical weapons.

Building Your Unique Sect

Collect resources and study construction, manufacturing, and art to choose a cultivation path that aligns with your sect's development.

Leverage architectural knowledge to build grand halls, lofts, and pavilions, integrating them with disciples' daily life facilities to exhibit your appreciation for Eastern architecture. Ensure thoughtful design of storage spaces to prevent damage to materials under poor conditions and high temperatures. Provide suitable living quarters for disciples to boost their morale.

Of course, don't forget to construct defensive structures such as walls and arrow towers to eliminate greedy bandits and ill-intentioned martial world rogues.

Competition or Cooperation

Develop independently in the martial world, or seek reliable allies. By engaging with other factions, you can influence events across the martial landscape, gaining advantages in both offense and defense.

You can dispatch disciples to attack other sects' bases and cities, conquering them openly through the prowess of your skilled disciples amidst the bloody turmoil for power. Alternatively, use strategic diplomacy to safeguard your interests, or manipulate other sects from the shadows, watching the chaos unfold with delight.

Whether you choose to become the dominant force in the martial world, a shrewd diplomat, or a mastermind behind the scenes, the choice is yours.

data.about_the_game:
Prepare your mower and blower, and get ready to head to the heartland of mowing... Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 is heading to the USA to start a whole new career in the world of lawncare!

Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 (LMS2) is the sequel to Lawn Mowing Simulator, which builds on the rewarding working-sim feel of the original. Listening to community feedback, and internal reflections, LMS2 will offer an expanded take on professional lawn care and use real-world equipment from manufacturer partners Kubota, SCAGⓇ and STIGA!

New mowers and string trimmers will be included, as well as much requested leaf blowers!

Career mode gets a total overhaul for all you management fans with a 3D fully explorable HQ from which to run your business, as well as enhanced character customisation.

LMS2 will feature a new USA setting, with brand new locations and a wide range of jobs for players to take.

From suburban lawns to commercial and municipal locations, LMS2 will feature 11 locations (more than LMS1 did at launch). Most of these locations will have multiple contracts of varying size and theme - while the addition of new tasks like leaf blowing and weed clearance means that there will be more to do than just cutting the grass in every location.

We love that some of you out there have racked up amazing numbers of hours playing the first LMS (some more than 1,000!) - and we hope you will in LMS2 as well. So to help those hours of mowing gameplay continuing to feel fresh, we have developed a system where gardens can change over time with new features that change how you approach completing them.

One visit to a house might see it have a new series of flower beds added, then the next time an above ground pool or flagpole has appeared. This ensures that while you'll want to keep your loyal customers happy, not every visit to the same location is identical each time.

We know these have been wanted for a long time, and in LMS2 we have leaf blowers as a part of the core game for clearing up leaves, as well as grass clippings.

But leaf blowers wouldn’t be much fun without a lot of leaves to blast! So we've rebuilt the game up to be capable of a lot of grass... and a lot of leaves! In fact, in LMS2, tens of thousands of leaves can be blown around at once.

And as you blow the leaves onto your tarpaulin they'll be collected until it's full. Then it's time to pick up the tarp, empty it into a debris bag, and you're ready to go again until all those leaves are cleared up!

You won’t only have a leaf blower to get the job done! LMS2 will also give the player a trusty rake to help get leaves out of those hard-to-reach places.

A new line up of mowers and string trimmers will be available in LMS2, as well as the new addition of leaf blowers, with each one being meticulously recreated in game to be as accurate as possible. We’ve created this handy comparison to show how LMS2 at launch will compare with the original game when it released:

As you can see, LMS2 will feature more equipment than its predecessor, and we have great plans for even more additions to the line-up post-release - just like the original game!

But what are the mowers, string trimmers and leaf blowers? Well, here are the details! We’re delighted that Kubota, SCAG® and STIGA have all signed up to be a part of LMS2, while we will also be bringing back our own in-house brands Patterson and Knight as well.

We have invested a lot of development time in building a new grass system from scratch. This was one of the most important elements that we wanted to improve from the original game and you'll really be able to see at-a-glance the difference between cut and uncut grass.

This makes a huge difference to the satisfaction of your gameplay, flowers and weeds will now become a part of the lawn's make up, as well as much more variation in the uncut lawns grass heights, which will really highlight your efforts as a player to make an overgrown lawn look perfect.

data.about_the_game:
Mini Airways is a real-time management game with an air traffic control theme.

You will play as a busy air traffic controller in the game: directing planes to take off and land, clearing air traffic, upgrading airspace ...... And most of all, don't let them crash!


Each airport can accommodate up to 4 people online and supports the use of the Workshop map. You can work with your friends to jointly manage the same airspace to reduce the impact of mistakes and challenge higher scores!

Fast-paced, real-time ATC gameplay: Manage airspace, clear planes for takeoff and landing, and avoid near misses! In addition to the normal arrangement of takeoffs and landings, you also need to face the challenges of mountains, no-fly zones, and peak landing hours, so please concentrate!

Every time you finish one day's management, you will be able to pick an upgrade for your airspace and airport: auto holding, accelerating turns, increasing airspace, waypoints ...... upgrade and customize airports to keep flights running more smoothly.

As you increase your flight management records, you will gradually unlock a total of 19 airspace maps based on real-world airports—from Beijing Capital, Shanghai Hongqiao, Chengdu Shuangliu in China to Vancouver, New York in North America, and then to London, Amsterdam in Europe... Showcase your air traffic control skills across various global airports!

The game triggers random events under certain specific maps and conditions, featuring classic moments in aviation history: the miracle landing on the Hudson River, Air Force One crossing, emergency incidents, high-priority flights, etc.

The game offers three modes: Classic, Hardcore, and Sandbox.

In Hardcore mode, the airspace simulates real ATC operations without the ability to pause within the session;

In Sandbox mode, players have full control over waypoints, props, and landing intensity, allowing you to design their own waypoints and test the maximum flight density they can handle.

The game supports creating custom maps and mods. Players can import map assets, freely configure runways, restricted areas, and other terrains for gameplay. For those with more demanding needs in aviation management, they can create MODs for altitude, wind speed, etc., enhancing the strategic depth of the game.

Don't Miss Out!

As you’ve read this far, you must be a true fan!

If you are into ATC (Air Traffic Control), civil aviation, or flight simulation, then Mini Airways is definitely worth trying!

Our development and publishing team are enthusiasts of ATC and flight simulation. We have experienced and researched all kinds of air traffic control and flight simulation games available, most of which feature highly abstract graphics like Endless ATC or Air Traffic: Greenlight, or extremely realistic simulations like Global ATC Simulator, I am an Air Traffic Controller 4 (ATC4), Microsoft Flight Simulator, and X-Plane 12, which almost all opt for professional and complex routes.

By the way: Mini Airways plays more like 112 Operator and 911 Operator than Mini Metro or Mini Motorways.

However, for beginners who are not professionals, they might prefer a simpler entry-level product that doesn’t necessarily strive for realism but focuses on gradual terminology explanations and functional guidance. We believe this approach can help grow the somewhat niche community of ATC enthusiasts. This is why we developed Mini Airways.

Since its release half a year ago, Mini Airways has received a lot of positive feedback and suggestions. It even made a small appearance in the East China Air Traffic Management Bureau’s skill competition. Thank you all for your support! Based on feedback from reviews, we are continuously optimizing the game to balance professionalism and gaming enjoyment.

In the future, we will work hard to bring more new maps, new events, and even explore new features (such as voice control similar to sim4D ATC). Mobile development is also underway, so stay tuned to our Steam page for updates! See you next time!

data.about_the_game:
Sam is a six-foot canine detective with a love of justice. Max is a hyperkinetic rabbity-thing with a taste for mayhem. Together, they're the Freelance Police. And they're about to save the world.

Good to have you back, little buddy!

In 2006, the comic book crime-fighting duo Sam & Max starred in the first full-fledged episodic game from Telltale, the studio that went on to make The Walking Dead and Batman: The Enemy Within.

Now everyone's favorite dog and rabbity-thing are back in Sam & Max Save the World Remastered, a new version of their first season of episodic games that has been lovingly updated by a small group of the original developers with the blessing of Sam & Max creator Steve Purcell.

Return to the adventure game that was once called "gaming's first sitcom" and is today known as "the remaster you didn't know you were waiting for." With enhanced graphics, new widescreen and gamepad support, five new musical tracks, and the same brain-tickling puzzles and offbeat humor that won it IGN's Best Adventure GOTY award back in the day, Sam & Max Save the World Remastered is a modern classic that you'll love to play—or play again.

Now, let's go save the world...

It's just another day at the office for the self-proclaimed Freelance Police when the Commissioner calls in with a disturbing report: former child stars are running amok in the street! What starts as an open-and-shut case of idiotic vandalism balloons into an all-out conspiracy as Sam and Max encounter one miscreant after another who have been mysteriously hypnotized. (You can tell from the "spinny thing" they do with their eyes.)


Who's the source of this malfeasance, and what is their dastardly plan? Cracking this case will require Sam's nose for detective work, Max's lack of conscience, an assortment of inventory items, and a little help from neighbors Sybil Pandemik, Bosco, and Jimmy Two-Teeth. From Sam & Max's street to the White House lawn, inside the internet, and all the way to the moon, this baffling mystery gets weirder and funnier as it unfolds.

🚐 Minibus Simulator

Build your own minibus business and experience the daily rhythm of the city behind the wheel.

Pick up passengers from bus stops, deliver them safely and on time, and grow your minibus career step by step.

But driving is only part of the job.

You will leave your vehicle, load passenger luggage, refuel your minibus, change tires and take care of your vehicle like a real driver.

🎮 Steering Wheel Support

Steering wheel support is available. If your device is not detected automatically, you can configure it using the in-game setup wizard.

🎓 Get Your License and Become a Minibus Driver

Your minibus career starts at home.

• Go to the training center and pass the driving tests

• Get your minibus driver license

• Take a loan from the bank

• Visit the dealership and buy your first minibus suitable for your level

Now it's time to get behind the wheel.

👥 Pick Up Passengers and Start Earning

• Choose a route and start your engine

• Pick up passengers from bus stops

• Deliver them safely and on time to their destination

Some passengers travel with luggage.

You can earn extra money by getting out of the vehicle and loading their bags into the trunk yourself.

You can also take standing passengers to increase your income…

…but be careful.

🚓 If the police catch you during an inspection, you might get fined.

⭐ Progress and Grow Your Business

Complete tasks, level up and grow your business.

• Unlock new minibuses

• Work on more profitable routes

🔧 Take Care of Your Vehicle

Your minibus is your livelihood.

• Take it to service when maintenance is needed

• Refuel it yourself and pay at the market

• Rough roads may damage your tires

If a tire bursts:

• Buy a new tire from the tire shop

• Replace it yourself on the vehicle

Dusty roads will make your minibus dirty.

If you want, you can:

🚿 Wash it yourself with a pressure washer

🚗 Or use an automatic car wash

Remember…

If you take good care of your minibus, it will take good care of your business.

🚐 Expand Your Fleet

Use the money you earn to buy new vehicles.

• Carry more passengers with larger minibuses

Become the best minibus driver in the city.

🗺️ Explore the World

A large map with different atmospheres awaits you.

• City center

• Coastal roads

• Peaceful villages

• Forest routes

• Holiday districts

Get behind the wheel — or step out and explore the world on foot.

The Choices You Make, Make You.

Growing up in humanity’s first extrasolar space colony means navigating a new world full of wonder, danger, and beauty. Explore the wilderness, study, fall in love, discover strange creatures, and deal with the consequences of your actions. Your choices will directly affect the lives of your friends and the fate of the colony. What kind of world will you help make? Will you survive to enjoy it? Why do you remember doing this before?



Growing Up on an Alien Planet

You have your whole life ahead of you. Will you spend it studying in school, or diving into the intriguing flora and fauna of this new world? Will you introduce space-age technology, or live in harmony with nature? Will you battle massive beasts, or nurture future generations? Realized in brilliant watercolor, the world of Vertumna is yours to explore.



Your Pasts and Your Futures Matter

Everything you learn and experience will make you and your colony stronger. You will thrive and you will make mistakes. These formative moments - your memories, decisions, and friendships - become collectible cards you carry with you. Each season brings new obstacles on Vertumna. The battle cards you earn from your experiences give you new options for overcoming these challenges, whether that is navigating relationships, learning new skills, exploring the planet, or staying alive. Every decision counts, during this life and the next.




How Many Lives Will YOU Live?

The cosmos is full of incredible mysteries, and your ability to remember your past lives is one of them. There are dozens of different endings to your story. How many lives will it take to save both your colony and the planet? Are you ready to wake up again?

Features:

  • Use memories of past lives to explore 800+ story events.
  • Discover more than 250 battle cards as you grow up on an alien planet.
  • Play your best hand in challenge encounters to ace your math test or escape from a wild snapbladder.
  • Make friends, fight with your parents, go on dates, fall in love, and save the colony.
  • 29 wildly different endings based on the choices you make each month.
  • Pick from 25 colony jobs, like goofing off as a depot clerk, or surveying the valley.
  • Grow into 15 skills, including bravery, toughness, organization, and empathy.
  • Get to know 10 dateable characters, including dog-boys, aliens, hot politicians and stone cold killers.

data.about_the_game:
Trang is eighteen. Her home is like any other in that alley — a father, a mother, a little brother, a plate of cold rice waiting for someone to come home, and things nobody says out loud.

 

ONE DAY, ONE HOUSE, ONE GIRL

 

You live through a single day of Trang's life in first person: sitting in class listening to classmates gossip, cycling home, lighting the stove to cook for your brother, tidying up, waiting. No enemies to fight, no guns to fire. Only small things everyone has done.

 

SMALL THINGS

 

Cook a meal. Play a round of caro with a boy from class. Unclog the toilet. The game lets you linger over these trivial chores — because that is how an ordinary day goes, until it stops being ordinary.

 

THEN THE PHONE RINGS

 

There are moments the game will not tell you which choice is right. It only puts you there, and waits to see what you do.

 

FOUR ENDINGS

 

The story branches on what you do — including when what you do is nothing at all. Each ending is a different version of the same night. Replay any chapter to find the roads you missed.

 

A VIETNAM YOU MAY KNOW

 

The narrow tube house, the standing fan, the plastic table and chairs, the pavement beer stall, the dark alley. The game rebuilds a Vietnam many of us grew up in — neither prettified nor blackened.

 

The faces here carry the roughness of older games: imperfect, a little stiff, a little distant. That is deliberate — some things cannot be told if you look at them too directly.

 

ABOUT THE GAME

 

Single-player · First person · About 2 hours per playthrough · 6 languages: Vietnamese, English, Indonesian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Thai

 

THE GAME CURRENTLY HAS NO VOICE ACTING. THIS WILL BE ADDED IN A FUTURE UPDATE.

 

A game made by one person.

 

CONTENT NOTICE

 

Intended for players aged 18 and over. Contains domestic violence, strong language, and difficult subjects including human trafficking and sexual exploitation. Sexual assault is implied in places but never depicted: the screen fades to black before anything occurs. There is no nudity and no sexual imagery.

 

Please consider this before playing.

· Fight alongside your companions and venture deeper

Throughout your journey, you will meet a cast of distinctive companions and venture deeper together.

New regions will open, new allies will join your party, and new storylines will unfold.

With every step forward, you draw closer to their pasts—and to the hidden side of this world.

· Not your usual “move once, attack once” tactics game

Each character has a rich and versatile skill set, letting you freely plan an entire turn around your resources and chain multiple abilities together.

When your three party members link their actions together, a single battle becomes a layered, coordinated offensive of your own making.

· Knockbacks, collisions, terrain, and objects are all weapons

Height, cover, displacement, knockbacks, collisions, and battlefield objects and terrain all have a real impact on combat.

Slam enemies into obstacles, trigger chain reactions through objects, and use terrain to reshape both offense and defense.

Even a seemingly limited battlefield can keep opening up new tactical solutions.

· Repeated ventures shape each character’s combat style

As you push deeper, your characters continue to grow in new directions.

Skill Insights can change how abilities function, while talents, equipment, gems, and other upgrades can push the same character toward completely different builds and playstyles.

· Echoes open the path, memories reveal the truth

Defeat powerful enemies and obtain precious Echoes to advance the story and unlock deeper regions.

But that is only the beginning.

Keep venturing deeper and collect Chapter Memory Fragments to uncover each character’s hidden past—and the deeper secrets of the world itself.

Contact Us

Please leave us a message in the Steam discussion group, or send us an email at 382330596@qq.com.
